description:
Located in the center of Sultanahmet, a spacious, clean apartment with a capacity of 6 people.
200 meters from Sultanahmet Square.

Optionally, an extra bed can be added to the room for a 7th person at an extra charge. Please contact us for an extra bed. We have high speed free FIBER internet.
The apartment is on the 1st floor and the building does not have an elevator.

Open buffet breakfast is 10 EURO per person per day.

reviews.text: Actually the apartment is at perfect location, walkable from metro station, easy to reach to all places you want to visit in Al Fatih area, the stairs are little bit high and we had to be careful as we have kids, but we manage it, bathroom is small but enough, easy chicken and check out, clean and comfortable apartment, I dealed with my host only at time of arrival and leave but he was friendly and cooperative.

Great location, so close to the main tourist attractions. Everything in walking distance! Check-in was super easy as the keys were left at the hotel across the street. Apartment was clean and we enjoyed our one-night stay there. Communication was also easy and fast. There are steep stairs leading up to the apartment which should be kept in mind but we were helped with our luggage so this wasn’t really a problem.

The place was great! We had the room on the first floor so we were a little iffy the first night since we could hear people outside, but the street is generally quiet so it wasn’t an issue. The location is great! 5 minutes to the hippodrome/mosques, 7 minutes to the tram. Great places to eat nearby! Every rooftop breakfast we had was between 3 and 10 minute walking distance. Someone came by everyday to clean the room and provide new towels, toilet paper etc. there were 5 beds in total, a queen/king and a twin bed in the bedroom and 3 twin sized beds in the living room. Great for a family or group of friends! We had a later flight and were able to leave our luggage at the hotel after checkout. The hotel also ordered a cab to get to and from the airport! We were able to ask the hotel to do our laundry, the prices were a little expensive but worth it for us! This is a great stay and I would recommend it to anyone who doesn’t want to spend a ton of money on a luxury hotel!

The host was incredibly friendly and communication was on point throughout our stay. They were very helpful in coordinating transportation to and from the airport, which we really appreciated. The property itself looks nice, but we encountered some issues with the cleanliness. Upon arrival, the entire apartment, including the linens, had a very strong odor of smoke. To the host's credit, once we mentioned it, he used air freshener which helped significantly. However, the bathroom was extremely small and had visible mold, to the point where our group didn't feel comfortable using the shower. Great hospitality, but the property needs some deep cleaning and maintenance.

Perfect location, close to the square and blue mosque within walking distance. There is a supermarket nearby. Bus and tram stops are also close.
However we weren’t satisfied with our stay overall. When we arrived we were taken to the wrong apartment in the wrong building! Up two flights of steps only to find it wasn’t the one we booked.
The apartment is outdated with many maintenance and safety issues. It doesn’t look like the pictures at all!
The curtains are broken and let in a lot of light. The bathroom and front door did not close properly. The bathroom lock was broken! Although They did send someone to fix this straight away. The front door was a safety issue especially if you have children. One of the lamps in the bedroom is broken, you can only switch it off by taking the plug out. It is taped up where the switch would have been. The toilet seat is broken, the lid would just fall down every time someone sat on it.
We found there are other apartments and hotels at less the price in the same area.

description: Bright 3-bedroom apartment in the heart of Moda, one of Istanbul’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Just a 10-minute walk from Kadıköy Ferry Port and 15 minutes from the Moda park. Surrounded by cafés, restaurants, and boutique shops, it’s the perfect base to enjoy the city’s creative energy and lively street life.

reviews.text:
The place is much smaller than it appears on the photos. Specifically the leaving room is very narrow and is combined with kitchen while at the same time serving as a corridor for all rooms including bathroom.
The place needs total renovation: all walls were dirty with stains, bathroom had BLACK mold on the ceiling and on the tiles on the walls, here and there floors were crooked and cracked.
A lot of amenities didn’t work or were half broken: the vacuum cleaner stunk, there were broken drawers in the kitchen, some lights did not work, one room had no sockets, drying rack was broken, one fan was broken while the other one was half broken.
The place is on the 3d floor and the stairs are very steep (no elevator) and occasionally very dark because lights on the second floor occasionally do not work.
I need to say that it appears that there was cleaning before check in and all bedsheets and towels were clean.

Awesome location -- in the middle of restaurants and energy. It's now perhaps my favorite neighborhood in Kadikoy. A couple tips: when you hunt for the key box look toward your FEET. And on hotter days this place -- as listed -- does not have air conditioning. We made do and really enjoyed this cozy, clean space. Btw Demir provided great communication before, during and after our stay.

We honestly don’t even know where to start — this place was absolutely amazing. If it were possible, we would rate it 6 out of 5 ⭐️
The flat was perfect in every way. It was very clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed, even the smallest details like plugs and little things that many places usually forget. You can really tell that a lot of care and attention was put into this home.
The location in Kadıköy is great, and the whole experience was made even better by the host. He was extremely kind, helpful, and respectful. He adjusted the check-in time to be earlier for us and allowed a later check-out, which made our trip so much easier and more comfortable. His communication and attitude towards guests were excellent.
We truly couldn’t find a single mistake in the flat. We really loved our stay, enjoyed every moment, and felt completely at home.
Without any doubt, when we come back to Istanbul, we will rent the same place again. Highly recommended to everyone — thank you so

We had a great stay at Hanemo’s place ( and adults and 2 children). Felt like home, spotless, comfy beds, everything you need in the kitchen. We were able to check in early and this was amazing, great communication during our stay. The location is in the heart of Kadikoy, next to the restaurants and shops, it can be a bit nosy in the evening but this is something you can expect considering the location and it didn’t bother us at all and the kids loved it. If I come back I will definitely book again with Hanemo. Thank you for everything.

We had a great stay at Demir’s place. In the middle of the center of Moda, close to the ferry metro and shops/bars/restaurants. The appartment is spacious (we stayed with 2 persons and a baby) and clean. We felt at home. We were a little scared there would be lots of noise of the bars downstairs but it did not bother us at all, we did almost not hear anything.

description: Hello! This house is just a 10-minute walk from Istiklal Street, the most famous street in Istanbul. It is 20 minutes by bus or tram from the Hagia Sophia Museum, 5 minutes on foot from the Golden Horn ferry port (ferry port going to Beşiktaş, Kadıköy, Üsküdar), and 10 minutes on foot from the Galata tower. Love to everyone!

reviews.text:
I would like to share my experience during this stay.
There was no hot water or heating one night, and the temperature dropped to 4°C, making it difficult to sleep. I informed the host and followed the instructions to adjust the boiler, but it did not work. I also had to spend a lot of time waiting for replies and trying to fix it myself.
There was confusion about how to turn off the boiler, as the instructions provided were unclear and inconsistent.
I initially did not plan to leave a review, but the host later sent a message suggesting he would give me a low rating, or not review each other, which made me uncomfortable.
He also mentioned a house rule (not to pee while standing). Although I found it unusual, I followed it after being reminded the second time. However, he still used this as a reason to complain.
The room was not as clean as shown in the photos (cigarette butts and ants on the balcony).
Overall, I hope the host can improve communication, cleanliness and maintenance .

Outstanding value for money. Having a whole place to myself was important for my time in Istanbul, and Ali's place delivered!
Check-in was easy and personal, Ali welcomed me with coffee and showed me the details of the apartment. He's is super friendly and a great host and friend. During my whole stay he was super responsive, helping with local recommendations and anything else I needed.
Considering the price, don't expect Ritz-Carlton vibes, it's a home that Ali rents out when he is out of town! Lovely place in a quiet side street with a fresh breeze going from bedroom to kitchen when all windows are open.
Great location to explore Istanbul, just 10 minutes from big shopping streets and a short 5 minute walk to Karimpasa ferry port.

The accomodation is very cosy and offers everything you need, including a comfortable bed, an equipped kitchen and a nice balcony.
Ali is an amazing host. Helpful, respectful, social and an incredible cook. I can only recommend staying with him. I am a female traveller and felt welcome and safe from the very first second. Love to come back soon!

That was such an autentic expérience. I felt like I have been living in one of the little and neighbourhoods of Istanbul. walkway to the main street and public transportation is 5 minutes maximum. Ali Osman is a nice and respectful host. the house is very central and cheap accomodation option for whom in need! thank you for everything!HHIGHLY-RECOMMENDED!

My stay at Ali's Airbnb was exceptional. Ali became a friend. His habit of exchanging songs and exploring the city together added a unique value to my experience, allowing me to enjoy the local culture in a very special way. The room was clean and well-equipped, ensuring a comfortable stay. This experience went beyond what was expected, perfectly combining comfort and warm hospitality. I recommend this accommodation to those seeking an authentic and enriching experience. Thank you very much for the stay, Ali!

description:
Our fully equipped and beautifully decorated apartment with bathtub is located in Taksim/Cukurcuma; one of Istanbul's oldest neighborhood, with sweet cat gangs, is home to many museums and art galleries with art and culture on every corner.

There are plenty of hip coffee shops, restaurants, antique shops, museums and art galleries the moment you step outside of the building.

Cukurcuma is a lively (although peaceful) and authentic neighborhood which makes it an ideal base to explore the city!

reviews.text:
The apartment was exactly as described and as shown in photos. It was neat, clean and as we were staying for two weeks, we really appreciated a fully functioning kitchen.
We loved luxurious bathtub that was perfect to relax and recharge after a hectic day of exploring wonderful city of Istanbul.
The hosts were very kind to provide guests with istanbulkart and a digital guide for Istanbul.
The surroundings of apartment were quiet and very colorful. Museum of innocence(orham pamuk’s fans would know of the place!) is right across the street! There are also tonnes of cafes and restaurants nearby. Tram stop of Tophane is nearby so is Taksim square. In short all the main attractions are at walking distance... a perfect location.
Lastly Cetin is an incredible host. He was responsive, very helpful. He arranged for airport pickup and drop, was very patient in answering all our queries (:
I would definitely recommend this place!

I had a very pleasant stay at this apartment. The property was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. The location is convenient, with easy access to nearby shops and transport.
The host was responsive and helpful throughout the stay, making the check-in and check-out process smooth and hassle-free. The apartment had all the necessary amenities, which made my stay comfortable.
Overall, a great experience — I would definitely recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again.

This was probably the best Airbnb experience I’ve had! I’m truly blown away at how much I enjoyed my stay here.
The apartment was incredibly clean, comfortable and cozy, and was perfect for what I needed as a solo traveler.
The apartment is located in a perfect location in a quaint neighborhood. It’s very close to public transportation and there are a lot of really amazing restaurants and shops in the area.
An Istanbulkart (public transit card that you can load money onto) was available on the kitchen counter to use, which was incredibly helpful for me to utilize during my trip.
Hosts Asta and Cetin were incredibly communicative and accommodating. I appreciate how they checked in frequently and how they genuinely wanted to make sure I enjoyed my stay as much as possible.
I highly recommend this Airbnb if you’re looking to experience Istanbul in the best way possible!

You can truly feel the hospitality, care, and attention from the host. He helped us in several situations and generously shared all the information and guidance we needed without hesitation.
The location is excellent for travelers who enjoy walking and exploring. it’s close to the metro station and within 7–15 misnutes’ walk to several markets, shops, restaurants, and tourist spots.
The place is clean, well-organized, and fully equipped with everything you need: a washing machine, a dishwasher, a bathtub, a fully equipped kitchen, and even some helpful guidebooks about Istanbul plus a public transportation card, which was very thoughtful.
Highly recommended for those who value kindness, respect, and meaningful travel experiences. I’ll definitely come back again, inshallah

We had an excellent experience staying at this beautiful and comfortable place. From the moment we arrived, we felt welcomed and at home. The house was immaculate and well-maintained, with a modern and tasteful decor that added to the overall charm.
The kitchen was fully equipped with all the necessary appliances, including a dishwasher, which made meal preparation and clean-up a breeze. The bathroom was equally impressive, featuring a luxurious bathtub that was perfect for relaxing after a long day of exploring.
One of the highlights of the home was the efficient air conditioning system.
The surroundings were also lovely, with a peaceful and quiet neighborhood that offered a perfect escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. The area was safe and inviting. Overall, I highly recommend this Airbnb for anyone looking for a cozy and convenient place to stay. The hosts were responsive and attentive, ensuring that all our needs were met during our stay. I look forward to returning here

description: Our newly built place in the center of Kadıköy offers a modern and comfortable life. The bedroom and bathroom are together. The whole place is all yours. There are no common areas. All items are new. We offer a safer accommodation service because it has a steel door. The room has a large double bed, television, air conditioning, refrigerator, table, armchair, wardrobe, bedside table, kettle and welcome tray.

reviews.text: Konum olarak çok iyi, oda büyüklüğü uyumak dışında vakit geçirmeyecekseniz yeterli, banyo ve oda temizdi. Tek problem yorgan, yastık yıkanmış ancak temiz gorunumde degildi özellikle yorganda sararmalar vardi, verilen terliklerler de sararmıştıi bu sorunları hallederse 5 yıldızlı bi yer olabilir 4/5. Kendi battaniye terliginizi getirmeniz gerekebilir
Her şey açıklamadaki gibiydi. Oda gayet temizdi.

Odada öksürük krizine sokabilecek bir sigara kokusu vardı. Çarşaf ve yastıklar sapsarı, üzerlerinde kan lekesi var. Gece boyu diğer odalardan saçma sapan sesler duyuyorsunuz. Ucuz sayılır ama bu fiyatı bile hak ettiğini düşünmüyorum.

Hep tercih ettiğimiz bir yerdi fakat son 3 kalışımızda çarşaflar ve yastıklarda pis lekeler vardı (kan, kir vs) ve çok havasızdı sigara kokusu hakimdi odada. Temizlik konusunda daha dikkatli davranılmalı.
Her şey çok iyiydi

description: Enjoy the unique design of the glamorous suites with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, kitchen and jacuzzi.

reviews.text: Enjoyed my stay. Communication was easy and overall great host.
alles gut!
Nice place, nice staff.

description:
This apartment is specially designed for our guests who enjoy a glamorous, quiet stay in an exclusive location. The famous Galata Tower and Istiklal Street, where you can discover some of Istanbul's best restaurants, bars, nightclubs, movie theaters and retail facilities, are only two minutes away.
Ideal for short-term stays in Istanbul, our apartment blends the city's vibrant culture and history.

reviews.text:
This location can’t be beat if you’re interested in the Galata Tower neighborhood! You’re right by the Main Street that leads to the tower. It’s a lovely view and maybe 3 minute walk to the tower. Along the way there are shops, cafes, a cat museum. Great safe area, and surprisingly quiet for how close you are to a major attractions. The host gave us instructions ahead of time and photos to help up locate the Airbnb, which was extremely helpful because it’s in a nice alley right before the main road to Galata. The bathroom offered shampoo, body wash, loofas, a dental set and other nice amenities. You do have to walk up narrow steps (we were on the 4th floor) and there isn’t an elevator. We didn’t mind but if you are wary of this, something to keep in mind.
Overall I would absolutely recommend this location.

pretty clean and functional small 2 bedrooms, there's no living room and restroom is really small with a shower. location is the best. perfect for people staying for activities around the place. comfortable bed and quiet place to rest. host is very responsive

A great place to stay in the heart of Istanbul.
Exactly as described. Two bedrooms and a bathroom, no sitting room.
Fantastic price, clean, amazing location.

Wonderful location, just a short walk to Galata tower and to Istiklal avenue. Wonderful terrace just as you see it in the pictures. Very responsive and helpful hosts. Possibility of storing your luggage before/after check-in. Great value for money. Thank you to the hosts 🙏🙏🙏.

The place was very clean, accurate to the pictures, and in an absolutely brilliant spot (can see Galata tower and close to bars, restaurants and shops).
The apartment was a little small, with no dividing door between main bed and bunk beds, and the shower had no curtain. But these things were only a minor inconvenience to an all round great place.
And the terrace views are spectacular.

description: The apartment is a 5-minute walk from the metro, tram and ferry stations. It is the perfect place for those who want to visit the best sights of Istanbul. It is located on the first floor and a sea view. The neighborhood is close to most of the tourist attractions. By walking Dolmabahce Palace & Museum of Painting and Sculpture and Galataport Shopping mall by the Bosphorus are easy to access. By tram, you can go to Old City (Hagia Sofia, Blue Mosque and Topkapi Palace area) in 10 min.

reviews.text:
Superb airbnb in Istanbul:
-Fantastic location. Walking distance to bus, trams terminals to Sultanahmet, Kabatas pier to Kadikoy, a leisurely easy walk to the elegent neighbourhood of Ortakoy.
-Dolmabahce Palace Museum & Mosque is diagonally across.
-Beautiful view of Bosphorus fr the living room.
-Quiet, clean & a well-equpped kitchen.
-the host Mr Bahadir is simply awesome. I left my jacket behind in Cappadocia & the hotel there could not find a solution to send the jacket to me. Mr Bahadir stepped in on his own initiative, contacted the hotel, made many calls back & forth, told the hotel to put the jacket on an overnight bus, so that it can get to Istanbul in the morn, co-ordinate wt the bus driver on the time & bus station in Istanbul to meet up, picked up the jacket & brought it to me just before I have to leave for the airport for my flight home. He is an amazing 10*host! He did all this for just a jacket, AND you know you are in safe hands! I'm definitely coming back!

As a mobility-limited family, within VERY hilly Istanbul, Gamze's apartment was a PERFECT location -- right on the Bosphorus with excellent public transportation options (tram, metro, buses and ferries) all immediately accessible (within 300 meters -- all flat). The apartment is on the first floor of a lovely building with about eight stairs to climb from the building's entrance door. The large, two bedroom apartment is very well laid out with a modern, stylish kitchen and dining/living area. The view is absolutely fabulous and not too noisy due to high quality windows. Gamze was a fantastic host, always response and supportive. Bottom line -- we loved this place and we will definitely be back!

I really liked everything, thank to the host for being kind and easy to communicate with. He helped us with early access to the house . He arranged a taxi for the airport. The place is suitable for elderly people. Although it was on little cliff but mum can walk . You can find everything you need inside the house. I really felt like my home.The location and the view were more than perfect. It is near to Kabataş Tran ,The underground that took you to Taksim meydan & different places Osama bay, Mecidiyeköy,şişli
Adal Rahman and his wife Hajar were kind and friendly. They cleaned the house quickly & helped me find out the market.There is only one thing I wish if you put a door for the bathroom in the second bedroom & a curtain in the kitchen window . I recommends the house and am going to stay for another time . Her şey için teşekkür ederim gerçekten çok güzel bir tatil sağ ol.

Gamze's and Bahadir's appartement is really wonderful - spotless clean, well equipped and very well maintained. It's very cosy with lots of books and pictures on the walls and a wonderful view of the Bosphorus. Communication with Bahadir was very easy and he was always very quick to respond and the nicest person to talk to.
However we were not so happy with the location: As others pointed out it is rather central with all means of public transport nearby - but it's also located next to one of the busiest streets with heavy traffic noise during the day. If you spend the day out exploring the city and come back after dinner, you'll probably be fine, as the traffic calms down during the night. But if you plan to spend more time inside to take a break or to work - just be prepared, that it can be noisy.

Our stay was Fantastic 💖
The house has modern design and a fully equipped kitchen, which was great for cooking. The location was ideal; the window view was amazing and very easy access to transport like tram and bus. Check-in was smooth with clear instructions and the space was generally clean. Overall, a good value for money and a pleasant stay..

description: You will not be far from the comfort of your home during your stay in this large one-bedroom apartment with an additional seating area, an integrated kitchenette, and a spacious bathroom , which is located on the main street in the center of the famous Sisli area. In this apartment located in our hotel, we have a reception 7/24 , the entire hotel is monitored by a camera security system that operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. We also have a big elevator in the hotel.

reviews.text: We loved the apartment. It was clean and in a great area. You can cook a small meal in it if necessary, but we didn't use the kitchenette. The host was friendly and communicated well. I would return if I am back in the area.

Konum olarak çok merkezi ve güvenli bir yerde bulunuyor. Giriş ve çıkışlarda personelin ilgisi çok iyidi. Güleryüzlü ve nazik personeller ile iletişim halindeydik. Odalar çok temiz ve ferahtı. Yeniden tercih edeceğim bir hizmet sunuldu. Tüm personele çok teşekkür ederim
Oda tam fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Personel çok yardımcı oldu. Konum harika ve her yere yakındı. Engin Bey’e çok teşekkür ediyorum. Kesinlikle hem kendim hem de arkadaşlarımla ziyaret edeceğim bir yer.
Harika bir yer düzenli olarak konaklıyoruz.En ufak bir negatiflik yok.
Güzeldi.

A wonderful place located in a central location.
Great host!!!
酒店在离主路很近的地方，周围有超市，走到公交站1分钟，很便利、很安全，隔音也不错，晚上睡觉还挺安静的。另外两位前台也很友好，会安排打扫，每天也很热情的打招呼。

description:
Relax with the your family and friends in this peaceful place. Enjoy barbeque and green areas with full sea view from all rooms, salons, gardens, and terraces. Enjoy Communal Swimming Pool. Visit wonderful beaches, shopping malls, restaurants and coffee shops. Villas are 18 minutes from Tüyap Fair Convention and Congress Center, and 30-minute drive from Istanbul International Airport (IST) via highways.

More options available in Airbnb for Nora Marmara Luxury Villas in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Overall we thought our stay was excellent. The house was very spacious and clean - just like the images. It had everything we needed.
The location was also very accessible - very close to the beach and supermarkets.
The costumer service was also very on point. Communication was very fast and response time was very quick.
We also want to thank the host for offering us the swimming pool on our final day which was very clean.
We recommend this property to anyone looking to spend there night in Kumburgaz.
We look forward to coming again.

Harika bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Ev oldukça temiz, konforlu ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Konumu çok iyiydi ve ihtiyaç duyabileceğimiz her şey düşünülmüştü. Ev sahibi çok ilgili ve iletişimi kolaydı. Tekrar geldiğimizde gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebileceğimiz bir yer. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

Villa geniş ve imkanları gayet güzel geniş aileler için rahat edebilecek bir ev tipi. Bahçede güzel vakit geçirelecek ve mangal yapılacak alan mevcut. Bahçede oturacak alan mevcut. Evin içi geniş rahatlıkla her alanda oturabiliyorsunuz. Evin içinde çokça lavabo ve wc mevcut. Konaklama civar sakinliği sitenin sakinliği güzel tavsiye ederim. Sadece giderken kişisel nevresimlerinizi götürmenizi tavsiye ederim. Mevcut evde bulunanların temiz konusunda şüphemiz mevcuttu.

Ev sahibi girişte evrak işlerimizi hallettikten sonra arkadaslarımızla rahatça eğlenebileceğimiz rahat bir ortam sağladı.
Bahçenin fıskiyeleri belli saatlerde açılıyor, orada eğlenmek isteyen misafirlere duyrulur ♥️
Ev sahibimiz yardımcı oldu her şey için fakat ev temizlik konusunda yeterli değildi

description:
Beautiful and comfortable apartment in the heart of Istanbul, perfect for families or small groups.

🏡 Two bedrooms
🛋️ Spacious living room
🍳 Fully equipped kitchen with natural gas stove
🧺 Washing machine & refrigerator

📍 Amazing central location
* 2 min walk to Galata Tower
* 4 min walk to Galataport
* 3 min walk to Tophane tram station
*5 min walk to Karaköy

Cafés, markets and metro are all nearby.
We would be happy to host you in our apartment 😊

Best regards,
Şaban

reviews.text:
I recommend this Airbnb! For the price, it exceeded our expectations. We had a beautiful view that made our stay even more enjoyable. The location was very central to the Galata Tower, which was a huge plus. There was also affordable parking nearby, making our stay very convenient.
The service was top-notch; the hosts were incredibly accommodating. Whether we needed extra towels or a second key, they provided everything promptly.
However, there were a few downsides. There were construction works happening nearby, which could be a bit noisy at times. Additionally, the water flow from the shower head was quite low, and the holder for the shower head was broken, which made showering a bit inconvenient.
Overall, this place offers great value for money, and if you're looking for a comfortable stay with excellent service in a great location, this is a great option!

The location was great and well connected to transit. The place was clean and quiet with plenty of space for 4 people. Our plane landed early in the morning and the host kindly let us store our luggage in another apartment in the building while our room was being prepared. Keep in mind it’s a 4-floor walkup with no elevator.
There wasn’t very much cooking equipment in the apartment. The smaller bedroom’s curtain wasn’t big enough to cover the whole window, so street lights poured in at night and the sun in the morning; it never got fully dark in the room. The bedroom doors have a window into the hallway, so light pours in from the other bedroom as well. The bathroom would smell of cigarettes -and sewer sometimes, which we think is because of the air filtration system thoughout the apartment.
Overall, our stay was fine and we enjoyed our time.

Me and my family stayed in the apartment of Şaban for a few days and let me tell you it was just a delight! Such a pleasant surprise for us! First of all, our host was very responsive and polite. The location of the place is perfect, everything is walking distance.
The apartment itself is very spacious, clean and it gets a lot of light. The view on the city is simply astonishing!
The place has everything you need for a pleasant stay - kitchen has all the necessities, big dining table and there’s two comfortable sofas in the living room.
Beds are comfy and rooms have a beautiful street view.
Not to mention a terrasse with an absolutely breathtaking view on the city which was open for us. Thank you, Şaban.
I absolutely recommend it to everyone coming to Istanbul. You will not regret it.

We had an amazing experience! The place was spotless and beautifully kept — you could tell the host takes great pride in maintaining it. The location was easy to find with the clear instructions provided. The host was very responsive and made sure everything was perfect for our stay. It truly felt like a hotel-quality experience with the comfort of feeling right at home. Would absolutely book again and highly recommend to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and hassle-free stay!

2+1 dairede konaklamamızdan genel olarak çok memnun kaldık. Dairenin konumu gerçekten oldukça avantajlı; kafe, restoran ve marketlere yürüme mesafesinde olması büyük kolaylık sağlıyor.

reviews.text:

Cihan is an amazing host who cares about the comfort and safety of his guests. He responded immediately to any questions I had. I was traveling alone and Cihan made certain I felt at home in his apartment.

A gem in the charm of Istanbul.

Cihan Bey’s apartment was the most beautiful place I’ve ever stayed in. It is located in the highest floor of a historical building. He made everything super easy and always responded within minutes if I had a question. He felt like more of a friend than an apartment manager! I didn't want to leave and would stay here again in a heartbeat!

Kesinlikle tekrar tercih edeceğimiz bir yer, gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz.

Ev genel olarak temiz ve düzenliydi, olanaklardan memnun kaldık. Arkadaşlarımızla 8 kişi kaldık yeterince yatak, odalar banyo evde mevcut çok rahat ettik. Zamanımızın çoğunu havuzda ve havuza yakın salon ve mutfakta geçirdik. Mutfakta gerekecek temel malzemeleri bulduk. Ev sahibimize hızlı yanıtları, yardım severliği ve esnek giriş/çıkış saatleri sunması konusunda çok teşekkür ederiz.

Bekârlığa veda partimiz için bu evi kiraladık. Ev oldukça büyük ve ferah; üç katlı yapısıyla 8–10 kişinin rahatlıkla konaklayabileceği geniş bir alana sahip. Bahçesi geniş, havuzu keyifli ve içeride ihtiyaç duyulabilecek temel mutfak ekipmanları ile diğer malzemeler de yeterliydi.
Bununla birlikte, rezervasyon öncesinde erken giriş yapabileceğimiz belirtilmesine rağmen bu mümkün olmadı. Eve giriş yaptığımızda ise temizlik beklentimizin altında kaldı; özellikle detaylı temizlik konusunda eksiklikler olduğunu düşündük.
Konumu biraz sapa olduğu için ulaşım bizim açımızdan zorlayıcıydı. Ayrıca çıkış saatinde esneklik talep etmemize rağmen kabul edilmedi ve saat 11.00’de evi boşaltmamız istendi.
Genel olarak evin büyüklüğü, bahçesi ve havuzu beğendiğimiz yönleriydi. Ancak yaşadığımız bu olumsuzluklar nedeniyle deneyimimiz beklentilerimizi tam olarak karşılamadı. Bu sebeple tekrar tercih etmeyi düşünmüyoruz.

9 kişi 1 gece konakladık ve her şey harikaydı! Özellikle doğa içindeki konumu, evin temizliği ve düzeni beklediğimden çok daha iyiydi. Şehrin gürültüsünden uzak, huzur dolu bir vakit geçirmek için mükemmel bir yer. Ev sahibi de çok ilgili ve yardımseverdi. Tekrar gelirsem kesinlikle burada kalırım, herkese tavsiye ederim
Ev gerçekten çok temizdi. Konumu ve etrafındaki doğa da çok güzeldi. Ev sahipleri bizimle çok iyi ilgilendi, her konuda yardımcı oldular. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

The apartment is located just about 5 minutes from the shore, which was definitely a highlight for us. There are also supermarkets, plenty of restaurants, and shopping options nearby, which made everything very convenient.

reviews.text: Sadik is responsive and helpful, and was incredibly generous in extending my check-out time. The apartment is large and comfortable. If you’re a light sleeper make sure to have an eye mask with you—the bedroom floods with light at sunrise, and I was never able to sleep past 6am. The neighborhood is central and easy to navigate (but note that Cihangir is extremely hilly and you will have to climb hundreds of stairs). Tons of cafes and ferry station is 10 minutes away.
This flat worked really for my one week solo trip to Istanbul. The photographs are accurate. The place was clean and the host was kind.

The living area was spacious with an AC unit. The bedroom was large and with a good AC although rather noisy. We did find the decor and ambiance of the apartment to be a little lacking. But it was very comfortable.
We found the there was a fair bit of street noise though and sometimes it was difficult to enjoy the apartment, especially if you opened a window while cooking. We also did not feel too much privacy in the living space due to people on the ground floor and opposite buildings being able to see in, but not much that can be done about that.
The host was very responsive and nice.

description: An awe-inspiring view of the Bosphorus greets visitor as they enter the historic Cihangir residence. Guests can expect to be amazed by the apartments design, which includes wooden floors and high ceilings.

reviews.text:
Great apartment, I sincerely recommend it to anyone!
Pros:
- The Bosphorus view is really impressive. Sitting in the living room with such a view under the rays of the morning sun is an unforgettable experience!
- Perfect location: Taksim, Istiklal, T1, groceries, cafes etc.
- Apartment is spacious, comfortable and well-designed, has all kitchen amenities.
- Check-in and check-out with the lockbox.
- Responsive host.
Cons:
- Unsafe exit from the elevator.
- We spent 10-15 minutes opening the outer door of the apartment. I'd suggest to replace the lock.
- No place to hang coats in the hallway, the wardrobe was locked.
- Kitchen furniture needs maintenance: countertop near the sink is cracked, some kitchen cabinet door hinges are ripped.
- Some dishes were not very clean.
- No wardrobe in the second bedroom (although it is shown in photos), only a chest drawer.
- No shower curtain.
- In the photos, there are pieces of art on the walls of the living room. In fact, they are missing.

The host (agency) arranged for us to be picked up at airport for a separate fee. Our plane was delayed so we were grateful that they were still there an hour and a half later! We were met by Zeynep and her colleague at the apartment, who were friendly and polite and gave us keys and all the information we needed.

The apartment was just like the photos, clean and spacious with wonderful views over the Bosphorus. We particularly loved how the large windows could be opened wide, opening up the apartment to the beautiful view. There's a small balcony at both the front and back of the apartment. There's also a tiny little lift to take you up to the 5th floor which is handy. Only issues with the apartment was the mold on the bathroom ceiling and lack of bath curtain, so the floor tends to get wet! No problems with anything else.

The apartment is located on a fairly quiet residential street. A bit of noise can be heard from the street below when in bedrooms with windows open (though didn't affect me, light sleepers may notice). The local area is great for the multitude of little independent cafes, bars and shops. You are no more than a ten minute walk to the main shopping street which is packed all day and night. If you want to get to the main sites, then you can walk 10 minutes down the hill to the tram (with some great little coffee shops and bakeries along the way) and be at the Blue Mosque/Grand Bazaar in half an hour. There's also a funicular train running up and down the hill between Taksim Square and the tram if you don't fancy the walk. If you are really keen on having the main sites on your door step then I would recommend staying in the old part of town across the bridge from Gelata tower. If you want a more local experience (Beyoglu seems to be where all the cool kids go) then I'd definitely recommend this area.

Overall our stay was very enjoyable and I would recommend this apartment to all people visiting Istanbul.

My wife and I stayed four nights in Istanbul to celebrate her birthday on February 1; we were in the apartment with our son and his girlfriend, who joined us for the celebration. Located on the fifth floor (with lift) of an old (somewhat restored ) building, the apartment has many attractive features: Large (over 100 sqm) size, beautiful/stunning view of the Bosphorus and Bosphorus bridge and the old city, great location in walking distance to shops, restaurants, Taksim square and the famous Istiklal avenue. It has however a number of negatives for its price category, when you factor in the daily cost of over $220/night (each guest above 2 persons faces an extra $$ charge per night): Need for a major overall paint and plaster work as paint is peeling badly in several rooms, wood flooring is damaged/rotten in several areas; the furniture and decor are quite mediocre with only one real bed in one bedroom and an uncomfortable sofabed where my son and his girlfriend slept (when I reserved the apartment we were told that there was in fact another separate bedroom also available - which did not yet show on the site - but this turned out not to be the case when we arrived); the bathroom is un- finished with a mirror so low that only a 10 years old could see himself in the mirror; several windows do not close well , letting air come in .. which was a bit uncomfortable in cold January; no simple common supplies such as salt, sugar.. and cubes for the washing machine which we have (pleasantly) often found in other apartment rentals from Airbnb. In addition the overall rental set-up feels very commercial with a legalese contract to sign upon arrival and a lengthy 2 pages document to read, which outlines the "many" renters' responsibilities and liabilities; there are also extra $$ charges if you check in after 6 pm or after 10 pm, or if you check out after 11 am. Overall, this gives quite an unpleasant business/greedy feeling to this rental which takes out its potential great charm (the offer to provide taxi transport from the airport is also overpriced). So, because of the above reasons and while we eventually enjoyed our stay in the apartment, I can only give 3 stars as my rating. A little investing by the owner in a plaster/paint job and in amenities (overall at a probably low cost) would go a long way in making this apartment a REAL stunning place !

Great apartment. Very comfortable. View is wonderful. See the Bosphorus from living room, Galata tower from bedroom. Location can't be beat - 10 minutes or less walk to Taksim, Istiklal, or the T1. Quiet area with many cafes nearby. Grocery steps away. Has an elevator, which makes coming and going easy, although be aware that the elevator is small and opens to a spiral staircase, so be careful getting in/out. Good wifi. Apartment could use a little maintenance, but the bones are good. Lots of windows (all new and very nice windows) and good fresh air flow through apartment. We'll definitely try to stay here again if passing through Istanbul.
The host Ilker is great - quick/easy communications, easy check-in and check out. Recommended.

The apartment was located in a great neighborhood with good access to restaurants, shops and public transport about 10 mins walk away. The view is incredible and the apartment is spacious. The beds were clean and comfortable. The correspondence in the lead up was great and the private transfers to and from the airport that they organised were a must in my opinion. The kitchen is well equipped to cook your own meals and a good sized fridge. A few things to note: There is no air conditioning or fans so I think that could be an issue in the height of summer.It is quite noisy at night with a lot of activity into the early hours of the morning so don't forget your earplugs. There is a steep spiral staircase with a tiny lift and if you are elderly this may be an issue getting suitcases upstairs.

description: the apartment is on the 4th floor and there is no elevator

reviews.text:
I recently stayed at Halil's Appart Hotel in the heart of Taksim, and I must say, it was a great experience. The location of the hotel is perfect, right in the center of all the action and easily accessible to all the amenities that Taksim has to offer.
Halil himself is a wonderful host and took great care of me during my stay. He was always available and ready to help with any questions I had. The hotel is well-maintained and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. The room is spacious, clean, and equipped with all the necessary amenities such as a kitchenette, a comfortable bed, and a clean bathroom.
One downside to the location of the hotel is that it can be a bit noisy due to the hustle and bustle of the surrounding area. However, this is a small price to pay for being in such a prime location.

Halil is very nice host, we were happy about place and communication. Istiklal is near, but it's quiet outside, it's comfortable to reach the apartment because metro is near. It's clean inside the apartment, Internet is enough for working
The only disadvantage I would like to mention is that the flat is on the 5th floor and building is without elevator. For some people it could be difficult to get there

Nice and clean apartment very close to the Taksim square. Halil is very attentive and responds quickly, also late at evening. I booked spontaneously the night before and could enter the apartment before check-in time. The apartment was cozy and clean, the bed comfortable, the internet worked and the price reasonable. So absolutely nothing to complain :) The pictures currently shown on the apartment page are a mix of pictures from this and other apartments in the building, but they are of a similar quality so this didn't lead to a disappointment.

Halil is very friendly and helpful host. He helped us to bring the luggages upstairs, since there were no lifts in the building, as well as put us in touch with a cab driver to get to the airport with fixed price.
The place was overall clean. The bathroom is clean although not in good condition (very old building). The few thing like bins, and proper duvets were missing in flat. But the amenities described in advertisement are there. The area is very lively and busy and not too far from historical buildings.

Halil was a very good host, super responsive and helpful. despite the flexible check-in, he came to say hi and meet in person. He was available for any assistance we needed and was eager to advise and help us. The communication was perfect. However, the apartment condition does not follow the high-class service of Halil. The furniture in the bathroom is moist and in bad condition. Same situation also in the kitchen, the furniture was not good, missing parts, and full of dust and dirt. you could not feel easy to use. the apartment needs maintenance and also a better decorative touch. a big no-go for us is that it was missing an elevator while it is located on the 4th floor!!!! We did not notice that when we booked or the info was not there. The steps were narrow, and moving the luggage was a struggle. The heat was perfect, and the location was amazing. 2 mins walk from the taxim square and right in the heart of the busiest road in Istanbul.

description:
Enjoy a comfortable and welcoming stay in the heart of Istanbul. This ground floor one bedroom apartment features a smart and modern layout designed for everyday comfort, set within one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods. The apartment opens onto its own private garden, offering a peaceful outdoor space to relax. Ideal for both short visits and longer stays.

Whether you are here to explore the city or work remotely, everything you need for a perfect stay is right at hand.

reviews.text:
It was without doubt one of the best AirBnB's I've been to. The location was amazing. It is right down the galata tower filled with antique bars and store. They did a modern renovation (in the old vintage neighborhood) and the room was super clean and bewildering. The bathrooms were surprisingly clean and the bedsheets and mattress were absolutely high quality. The kitchen was equipped with IKEA equipment's. The sleeping quality is perfect and the safety of the flat is controlled by trained security. The best part about the BNB was it's lovely balcony in which is a great place to hang out for hours.
I defenitly would choose this place for my next trip to Istanbul.

Lovely and quiet accommodation for such a busy tourisric area.
The room we had was on the ground floor, and had a shady courtyard to relax in. Spotlessly clean inside.
There was a security guard on site, so it felt safe despite no reception. Our host communicated promptly through messages and helped us to organise airport transfers.
My only consideration, which isn't related to noa itself is the accessibility of the surrounding streets, which are very hilly.
Otherwise lots of restaurants nearby, lots of little boutiques and of course, it's within minutes walk to the Galata tower.

This is a top choice for a trip to Istanbul. It’s in a very cool area with a lot to see on foot. The apartment itself is beautiful, clean, modern with a wonderful garden. The apartment barely needed air conditioning because it is so cool. Mosquito nets. Speedy, fast check-in. No hanging around. Loved it and will be back. Don’t hesitate to book this apartment.

Galata is a vibrant and intriguing area of Galata. Access to the tram to the main attractions is about ten minutes walk and ten minute tram ride. It is worth noting Galata area consists of very steep hills. The apartment was a quiet interlude away from the noise and bustle of Istanbul.
Great location! Very clean and the host Ruya is just great. Always available and super helpful. Thank you NOA for making our Istanbul visit great 😊

description:
The Apartment is in Karaköy, Beyoglu which is located very city center and also you can reach easily metro, tram and bus stations. Very close to Taksim, Galata Tower and main cafes, restaurants and pubs.

This a building which is operated by our company and we do have 10 studio apartment within same building. We have uploaded our studio to the gallery.

According to availability on the arrival date; one of the studio apartments will be assigned to our valuable guests :)

reviews.text:
Overall this place is okay but you get what you pay for. I would stay here again just not alone.
Pros:
- cheap
- spacious
- actual room was clean
- close to public transportation (Halic metro)
- there is an elevator
- the building has a code to enter so I felt safe inside
- they have a fridge with water and drinks that you take and pay for later which was convenient
- doing a late check in was very easy
- connecting to WiFi was easy
- REALLY nice staff and they reply super quick
- weekly cleaning was really nice
Cons:
- its located between small alleys that can be scary at night (make sure you stay here with someone, I was a female traveling alone and it was a little sketch at night)
- piping seemed to have a smell that would hit me right when I got home (I bought a candle/air freshener and it was good enough)
- WiFi was glitchy, would go out for 5 minutes every 1 hr
- sometimes water would not get hot enough to shower
- no view or rooftop terrace

Lovely apartments, lived for a week, was delighted!
+ fully view photos, stylish apartment
+ convenient location - in the center, within walking distance of all available places
+ Responsive staff, always in touch. help with anything question
+ excellent internet, speed up to 40mb
+ cleaning on request, everything is clean and tidy
Not cons, some observations:
- there is no extractor fan in the bathroom, this makes it a little damp in the apartaments
- high pillows are very uncomfortable for me :(

The room was overall good value for the money, with a few things that might need improvement. The host was nice and replied very quickly. The location is pretty good but in a very small alley in not the prettiest or cleanest area of the city. The room was fine, although it smelled of cigarettes and the bedding wasn’t of the best material and was quite hot to sleep in. Also if the guests on your floor are as loud as the ones next to us, you will definitely hear them. The bathroom and shower were clean, Galata tower is walking distance, as is the Sisane station which gives you access to all you need. The check in and out were fairly simple.

Decent stay, apartment was clean and as described. Though the neighborhood is not very good(we never felt unsafe, but it is very industrial and noisy). Less than 10 mins uphill to Galata tower, 8-10 mins walk to Haliç, Karakoy & Sishane metro and 5 mins to bus going towards Eminonu.
Bed was not super comfy and bathroom was very cramped.
Apartment has elevator and check in is very easy and flexible.
No privacy as your window opens up to other windows.

EXCELLENT PLACE to stay first I'm a professional host so I think I can judge. the place is in a prefect location cross the street is the metro station where you can go any where in Istanbul. 5 mins walk is the tram also, both of them with one station to Istiklal street, 2 stations to sultan Ahmed and Osmanbay and more.
supermarket and a restaurant with nice food is 2 mins walk. the room was heated very good bathroom is very good hot water elevator everything is clean the room got everything you need.
above all these mentioned before the most important thing is the team running this business they are great, they help you with everything you want thank you Irem thank you guys it was a wonderful vacation

description: Contemporary decorated. 3 Bedroom , 2 Bath , 220 meter sq. apartment. Large garden with patio, and balcony.

reviews.text:
Had a great time here! The garden is beautiful and even bigger than the pictures make it look. Completely surrounding by greenery, so it feels really private. Great place for me and my two dogs! Very quiet and peaceful space, but close enough to the main area for restaurants (an easy 15 minute walk, no hills). The house was incredibly clean and had everything you would need (minus Wifi).
My overall experience with the host and the stay was exceptional -- would recommend and will visit again, if they'll have me!

The place is beautiful and much bigger and spacious that it looks on the photos. Melih was very responsive and helpful. We had a wonderful time at the accommodation and couldn't recommend it more.
One thing which we didn't notice although it's stated on the listing is that there's no WiFi at the place. It wasn't an issue for us as we were on holiday but could be a downside for someone who e.g. is working remotely. We missed it when reviewed the listing, so it's totally on us for not being attentive.
Otherwise it's a gorgeous place in a beautiful location - very close to the beach.

A great place for a family vacation, clean and comfortable house. Convenient location of the house 15 minutes from the center. Cozy garden and great views. I recommend this magnificent house for a romantic or family vacation with children. Melih was a very helpful and pleasant person who was always in touch and was happy to help. 😇😇😇😇😇

Melih’s home is one of the best airbnb homes I have stayed at. It is spacious, quiet and spotlessly clean, tastefully decorated, and in a great location - close to downtown yet very clam, beautiful surroundings with fresh air. His communication was quick and effective, very kind and even provide us with wonderful amenities. It felt like a real home from home, never wanted to leave and we will definitely be going back. Highly recommended.

Spacious and bright with a comfortable terrace! We enjoyed the ample room and the comfortable garden terrace. The large windows flooded the space with plenty of natural light, creating a pleasant atmosphere throughout our stay. However, occasional passing cars on the nearby road were a slight inconvenience.

description:
TR/ENG

Our facility has five rooms and three different types of accommodation.

Apartment 5 is on the top floor and is a 1+1 suite room with a balcony. Apartments 4 and 3 are on the middle floor, we have two studio rooms, and finally, on the ground floor, we have two 1+1 reverse duplex rooms.

Our room in this profile is on the first floor and is a studio room where two people can easily stay.

It is a 3-minute walk to the coast of Ortaköy and transportation is easy.

reviews.text: This place is adorable but the foremost its clean and cozy and the communication and support by Meet is 1A+. I had a room only which was smaller in real than expected but it has all the necessities (desk, shower, toilet, kitchenette, bed, closet etc.). the location is very central in Ortaköy from which taxis are easily accessible and also buses. Mert was regularly checking in if all is in order and was very helpful when I needed a hair dryer that was not in the room organising one in literally 15 minutes. Due to the house being a bit oder, although authentic really, it can get louder during the night since the isolation is not so good. All in all, I definitely recommend this place and wish Mert and his family all the very best.

I definitely suggest this place for multiple reasons.
First the host: Mert always tries to help and he is always available. Even at the beginning when we had hard time getting a taxi he did us a favor and picked us up. During out trip he gave us advice regarding nice places to see and guide us regarding getting HESS code. In Turkey it's very important to have a good host, because things can go wrong like water or power cuts on district level for a few hours and mert was always on top of it, letting us know that it's from the city level and will be back soon.
The place itself is one fully equipped room with private shower and toilet in an apartment, which is located at a very nice part of besiktas in Istanbul. Walking distance to the Şehir Hatları Ortaköy Vapur İskelesi which is always fun and crowded. We saw multiple wedding pictures being taken while walking by the water.
When you talk to locals they might tell you the price is expensive, but their pricing is based on 1 year contract. Compare to hotels and other AirB&B places in that area, the price was very fair.
I will definitely come back here again.

I recommend staying at Mert's place. It's a wood based room that has everything you need in the small space. Clean when I arrived. Kitchen has all the necessary items, desk for working was bigger than expected, bed was comfortable, and still enough space to walk around the room or leave luggage inside. A/C is above the bed and there is a heater too. It's located in a part of Istanbul that's like a cute village with many markets and grocery stores, so you'll never have trouble finding fruit or items for the fridge to eat at home. Location also is quiet, you won't here a lot of noise coming from outside because it's away from main street and it's not as crowded as other parts of Istanbul.
Mert is very hospitable and always helped solve problems and answer questions immediately. I hope every airbnb host is like Mert.

Clean? Yes
Safe? Yes
Great location? Yes, walking distance to several local shops and markets, cafes and restaurants and various forms of nightlife. Beautiful and picturesque Ortaköy mosque is a 6-7 minute walk, as is the Bosphorus river where the mosque sits. Buses and Ortaköy ferry station are 5 minutes away. Beşiktaş transportation hub will take you to various parts of İstanbul - only 5 minutes to reach by bus. Ortaköy, like any other part of İstanbul, can get a little crowded, but certainly not as busy as most other areas. Mert’s building is just around the corner from the main street, away from the noise.
Although cleanliness and safety are key elements to look for when staying at any place, it’s Mert himself that made my stay memorable and enjoyable.
Mahdy

Great hotel-great man!
1) the hotel is in the well restored historical turkish building. So it increases the benefits from holiday cause you can feel the home atmosphere of the host-country. I am really tired of staying in standardized 'no-face' apartaments looking the same anywhere in the world. Here it is not the case. And it is great!
2) The room we stayed was normal in size just as we expected. Mert said he has also a 2-room apt. for greater comfort and I want to try it next time.
3) the great advantage is that there was completely no smell from the kitchen, toilet etc, the apt. is very clean!
4) interior design was also authentic and cosy.
5)Mert is the great host! Very polite and helpful.
So overall great stay in a great place! Mert good luck to you, your Father and your hotel! Many thanks again!

description:
35 smq Large, Bright and Modern Studio.

1 Queen size, spine friendly bed, full et kitchenette,luxury linens. 32 " tv with satellite and free wifi.
Very close to metro station and istiklal revenue.

reviews.text: Ali's place was exactly the way it looked in the photos, and the location was superb, gorgeous and convenient, close to the subway etc. Also it was clean and well arranged, and the shower facilities were great, an overhead rain shower as well as a handheld. His assistant Marina was very helpful in terms of the laundry, doing it herself, which was exceptional. My only criticism of the space is that there wasn't much privacy, it was just above the street grade, with 2 large windows opening onto the street, and poorly insulated walls, with noises carrying through. Ali himself seemed to be friendly overall through our text communications, but it said in the listing that he would himself meet me and explain the place to me, but that never happened, it turns out that had gone away on vacation without telling me. When I got to Istanbul itself, I frantically sent him several texts, but no response. When I got to the apartment, I didn't know at first how I was going to get the keys, scary!!!

This apartment is same as on the pictures. Very clean and nice for two people.
Positive: LOCATION is super nice to visit istanbul. Ali is a good and responsive host. Apartment clean, good bedding.
Negative-improvable: Internet is slow, especially in the evening, we had 1 day internet totally out. Bathroom is small, no shampoo, only bath gel provided. MISSING LIGHT, the appartement is very dark.
Overall, we recommend staying in this place.

Pros: very good location, Galata Tower and Istiklal street, the metro station in walk distance. From this location, you can travel through all of Istanbul without problems, metro, tramway, funicular, boats - everything is available and accessible. Very stylish apartment, beautiful design, very comfortable bed, shower - it's one of the memorable things in my life.
Cons: air conditioner work is not perfect, 3 of 7 night it's didn't cool, only blow air (AC placed not in the bedroom, so it didn't help)
I can't understand what's exactly wrong, but that's it: impossible to sleep in those conditions, so I hope Ali will fix that. On my message, he answered "no complains", so that makes me feel awful because I did complain right now. I've requested some help, maybe he can bring me a floor fan, but he answered: "can't help you".
First time in my life I don't want to return to the apartment in the evening because I didn't know - will AC work tonight or not?
Other major cons - horrible internet speed, it's slow, it's unstable. I'm remote employe, so I need a stable internet connection in my travels, but with this internet - I can't work, I even almost can't load Instagram stories, what can I say about video conference with my colleagues?
And Ali answered: "speed is not under my control".
Uh. My mobile internet was faster than Wi-Fi in the apartment, I have a 500 Mbps connection in my own apartment, so I can't understand Ali's position again. I do not believe that's in Istanbul everywhere the internet is so slow because in restaurants and cafes the internet did work well. Even opened public Wi-Fi network did work. But not in Ali's apartment.
So again - I hope Ali will fix that too because everything except AC and Internet was amazing, and I very upset to write all of these words.

My boyfriend and I stayed for a week at Ali's apartment, and cannot recommend it enough. The location is perfect - so close to the Metro station and super easy to get to/from the airport. But most of all, it is located in such a cool neighbourhood surrounded by beautiful boutiques and close to great restaurants. The apartment is on street level, but it is so quiet at night! Everything was immaculately clean and had all the amenities we needed (fridge, coffee machine, air conditioning, good wifi, toiletries etc). The bed was really comfortable and had good pillows. Ali is a fantastic host - great communication, check in and out was super easy, and he is a lovely guy! We really wanted to eat mezze at a restaurant called Asmali Cavit (5 mins walk, just off Istiklal Street) but you can only book by phone - we messaged Ali and he messaged back a few hours later saying he'd dropped by and booked a table for us :-) we had such a delicious dinner there (definitely recommend), and we are so grateful to Ali for going out of his way for us! We would recommend Ali's place to friends and family, and would definitely stay again.

We enjoyed our stay at Ali's place. He met us early for our check-in and the place was very accommodating. The place was very comfortable, including the bed. It was a convenient location and we loved the neighborhood with all the local shops though there's a lot of steep inclines when walking around. It's a three-story building so sometimes you can hear the upstairs neighbors from below but that can be for any apt building. The communication with the host, the neighborhood, and the proximity to Galata, Istiklal, and the Sishane train station made it worth it!

description: In a great location, one bedroom apartment. You can stay minimum for 5 days.

reviews.text: Excellent place. Better than the pix. Very clean and comfy, felt like home. Large kitchen, living room, bedroom, and bath. Great host and location too. You won’t be disappointed. Lots of nice touches make this a very inviting place. Book away.

The visit was really great! The apartment is super clean and Tuba is really friendly and kind as a host.
The location is perfect for sightseeing. There are many cafes and restaurants nearby.

The apartment is very cozy and incredibly comfortable to stay. It is made in a modern style and spotlessly clean. There is everything you need for cooking. The apartment is located in the center of Beyoglo district - near there are a lot of cafes and bars in the European style

Evin konumu oldukça merkezi, üstelik ev oldukça ferah, temiz ve konforlu. Ev sahibimiz Tuba Hanım da iletişime çok açık biri, tüm mesajlarımıza çok kısa sürede dönüş yaptı ve tüm konaklama sürecimiz boyunca bizimle çok ilgiliydi ve çok yardımcı oldu.

We stayed at Tuba’s place for 9 days. She was a perfect host and it was very easy to communicate with.
her apartment is amazing. Great location to access all the touristic places and the neighborhood was very nice and calm.
We will definitely come back.

description: A nice place for people who look for a neat but special cocoon in one of the most central areas of this vibrant city. Best for people working from home with its functional and peaceful quality. It is on 6th floor and there is no elevator as it is one of the old quality buildings of the area so it is up to guests' preference. The place is not available for parties or having guests often.

reviews.text:
Ezgi's place was really cozy and quiet. There is a fireplace that you can enjoy during cold winter nights, which added to the experience. It's a great place for short stay in a good location. I'd say it's very good value for money. I'd recommend staying here.
As for Ezgi, she is a great communicator, always accessible. She informed us on everything about the place prior to the stay. It was one of the best host experiences I had on Airbnb.

Location of the place is very good, near metro, it is a quite place with not much traffic, for the price is really good value. The place is big enough, I enjoyed the stay. Also Ezgi as a host is good, she speaks good English and there was no problem in communication. I would definitely recommend.

İlk günden son güne kadar, muazzam derecede yardımcı oldu ve kendi evimizde gibi hissettirdi Ezgi Hanım. Fazlası var, eksiği yok. Şahane bir deneyimdi bizim için. Lokasyon muazzam, her yere çok yakın, daire tertemiz, ilgili bir ev sahibi. 👌🏾

I booked it for my girlfriend and she spent two weeks there
she was really happy with the place, described it artsy and cosy with a peaceful neighbourhood.
also in her opinion the owner: Ezgi , is lovely, responsible and friendly :-)

I've spent 1,5 month at Ezgi's place and it was such a pleasure to stay there. Ezgi is a very great host, the communication is very easy and she has always been efficient to fix the little problems. The place is very cosy, has a warm vibe and the location is very convinient because it's close to the subway. It's a calm aera and building so it was perfect to rest after going to the city. I'd recommend fully Ezgi's place :)

description: A first-floor apartment in Sami Bey Apartmanı, built in the 1950s by my grandfather Dr. Zülfü Sami Özgen. Fully refurbished — new kitchen and bathrooms, heating and air conditioning — and furnished with kilims, İstanbul engravings and pictures of ships. 90 m², with windows on two sides of the living room looking out to Dolmabahçe Mosque, the palace clock tower and the Bosphorus. Three bedrooms, sleeping up to nine. First floor — 31 steps, no lift.

reviews.text:
We found the place as described. Since we were a big group, we booked 2 apartments in the same building. That was a good idea. Both places were clean, spacious, good sunlight and amazing view of the Bhosphorus.
All amenities were well functioning and well maintained. The place was also easily accessible by all forms of transport (tram, metro, ferry). It was not in the main touristy area of Istanbul so didn't feel too crowded as well. We really liked that.
The hosts Emirhan and Tuna were also very responsive. One night the fire alarm went off randomly to our surprise but the host were able to guide and resolve the issue ASAP. Thank you for that.

Pros:
Incredible view
Responsive host
Spacious
Great location
Washing machine
Walking distance to Besiktas stadium
Cons:
The water in the shower is temperamental. The water goes from warm, to piping hot, to freezing cold. Dangerous if you’re washing children so be mindful of that.
Sometimes there was no hot water so check first. I had to pull my son out of the shower with shampoo in his hair.
The picture of the living room shows 3 couches but there are 2
The pictures show a bathtub, there is no bathtub. Bummer if you planned on giving kids a bath.
The listing states there is a private room suitable for working and has an office chair - this is not accurate. There is not private room for working except to use a bedroom and sit on the bed.

What an excellent apartment. From the pre arrival communication to anything throughout our 10 day stay, Emirhan and his associate were so helpful and responsive. The apartment is clean and convenient, with a lot of comfortable sitting and sleeping space (for 5 of us). Lots of personal touches such as ample coffee, great kitchen ware, extra blankets. The view and location cannot be beat. We will definitely book this again.
Note: We had an excellent experience with the host, however Airbnb charged me for changing the reservation to a different unit listed by the same host in same building and never responded to my request for service and refund.

My wife and I lived in Istanbul for years, so when we came back for a brief vacation, we didn’t want to stay in the heart of the tourist districts. However, we wanted something with a great view and excellent transportation access. This apartment is it. We had a fantastic view of the Bosphorus - the pictures don’t do it justice - with easy access to the Kabataş tram and funicular lines to speed us away to wherever we wanted to go.
Emir is an excellent host, with great, rapid communication and help carrying luggage up the flight and a half of stairs to our apartment. He also got there early on our check-in day and saved us a public parking spot in front of the building, which is a rare treat if you’ve ever been to Istanbul.
This is a great location if you are looking for an excellent base to explore the city while not sacrificing comfort or views. The immediate neighboring blocks don’t have much in terms of a grocery store, and you’re close enough to the Beşiktaş stadium that you should be aware of home games if you like to go to bed early on Saturday nights, but due to the excellent proximity of the apartment building to mass transit options, you really can’t go wrong here. Bring your camera, your Istanbulkart, and your Beşiktaş jersey, and you will be happy to stay here!

Here are a few comments on our stay:
1. Great host and great and accurate communication.
2. Amazing location, 3 minutes walk from the metro/funicular/ ferry stations
3. Amazing view from the apartment and great access
4. The apartment is sunny and adequately illuminated, the rooms are spacious and the apartment is very clean and well furnished.
5. Reasonably priced for the value.
In a nutshell, it was a great experience and I would definitely recommend this stay to friends and family.

description:
Kadıköy Apart
We are honored to host you, our valued guests, in Kadıköy, one of the most popular districts of the Anatolian side, in the center of Istanbul. >>

reviews.text:
They were really helpfull Host. Check-in was really easy. Location is good. Host was so kind they gave me gift before I leave.
There was no any flowers or any plants in the whole apartment. Pictures are not real. Furnitures are really old and lots of place of furnitures was burn with cigaretes. Bathroom was clean BUT whole apartment were not. There were Turkish Coffee Cups in the kitchen BUT NOT any machine to do coffee. There was only kettle in the kitchen. Windows, the cornice holding the curtain was broken and almost fell on my head with the cornice. The photos look like they are from 10 years ago. The place was old.

The apartment was clean, very comfortable, and in a great location. We had a slight issue with the check in—on Air BnB the check-in time was listed as noon, but when I asked about it when making the booking, I was told it would be available at 1pm. That was fine, but when we arrived we ended up waiting in the lobby for about half an hour until it was actually ready for us to go in. The host was very polite and made us comfortable while we waited, but it was a bit frustrating. Otherwise the stay was very comfortable and a great value.

The apartment was comfortable and spacious, it was clean and the location was very convenient. Overall, good value for money. The only thing that could be improved is the wi-fi, which wasn’t very stable.
Very nice neighborhood near the beautiful waterfront and lots of young people. Place was very comfortable and spacious, and the front desk check-in/out was excellent

I had a great stay, it was a great home, air conditioning during summer absolutely necessary which this home has, its located on the first floor which makes it easy to access although there is no elevator but you dont have too many steps either. And overall a great person and an excellent host. Responded fast to any question I had. Definitely would recommend and would go back!

description:
We are locating at the heart of the Constantinapolis. As you can see we are just 2 mins away from famous street İstiklal by walk. And also 15 mins to Taksim Square. We are serving turkish breakfast with an opprtunity of amazing view to Golden Horn. Transportation is just 1 min away (metro, bus). 20 mins away from old town blue mosque area. İmpatiently looking forward to share our experiences and warm smiles. :) This room is 15 square meter

Breakfast is served for an extra fee. 15 USD per day

reviews.text: Cemil and his staff were very nice. Communication with them was great, they speak English fluently. The building is quiet and there is an elevator. Our Room was clean and the bed was very convenient for sleeping. There was a high speed internet access. Location is great, to Sishane metro station, Istiklal street and SOK super market is less than 1 minute walking distance., and 5 minutes to Galata Tower. There are lots of good cafes and restaurants just near by, and also vegan restaurant which was important to us. There is a lack of lighting in room that I think it can be solved easily by them. Thank you Cemil, hope to see you again.

i stayed in this hotel and it was a wonderful experience for me.
Great and helpful host with nice and good location so close to the metro station city center and so many historical place.
Great and nice view terrace for hanging out and wonderful breakfast.
Ofcurse my next choose for staying is this hotel.

Located just off the main streets this hotel provided a good and quiet stay away from the noise that's common in Istanbul. The room could use some additional attention to cleaning of the sheets but overall it was clean enough to work with. The rooftop deck offered a nice view of the sunset. I would recommend for a nice budget stay.

Amazing terrace with a view. Great location.
Personnel doesn't wear masks. Lady who makes breakfast doesn't wear a mask or gloves.
Breakfast was a bit disappointing. I am a vegetarian. The pre-assembled plate had sausages on them. I told the lady I don't eat meet and after some back-and-forth, she took sausages off my plate with her fingers. It'd be much better if she assembled a new plate for me (for vegetarians, it is very unpleasant to eat food that was touched by meat products).
Wifi does not work well on the terrace, unfortunately.
Warm hospitality and nice people. The hotel is in excellent location. Ideal place to hang around Beyoglu.

description: Our place is 5 minutes from the sea and is located on the ground floor. It is in the form of a studio and has all kinds of kitchenware. There are 2 single beds and 1 sofa bed. Ideal for escaping the stress of the city and enjoying a barbecue in the garden.

reviews.text:
Perfect holiday! Everything was excellent!
The house: Very clean, has everything, kitchen, nice bathroom, wifi, we had to work remotely in the week, so it is suitable for that as well, and after work chill in the hammock in the garden, eat salad from tomatoes and cucumbers from the garden. Looks good in the pictures, but in reality is even better!
The host: Very nice and helpful, speaks perfect english, always available on watsap even if he is not in the house, his parents are and he communicated all our needs to them, so they could help. Thanks!
The location: Yalikoy is very very nice Black sea village, with laid back and slow living atmosphere. Locals are very friendly, we were invited to dinner to the neighbours, made friends in a restaurant on the beach. There are few nice places on the beach, we had dinner in the center as well, everything very close on foot. The purpose of our trip was kitesurfing and paragliding, Ormanli plaji is 30 minutes away from the house by car, very beautiful wild beach with nice waves, and one of the best soaring paragliding spots. In the village itself you have Yalikoy plaji, which is also very big and very beautiful, and is 5 minutes walking from the house.
Totally recommend both Yalicoy as destination if you want laid back village sea experience, paragliding or kiting (bring big kites, wind is not strong), and Alican's place to fully relax and have everything you need, and more! We extended our stay as much as we could, and will come back hopefully!

Very cozy place in the middle of nowhere!
If you hate noisy and over populated places, then this place is definitely for you.
Small village with unique flavor and hospitale people.
Don't shy to be opened for this little world, and it will open it's doors for you.
There is a couple very decent restourants at sea cost (Koru and Fafatara). Also it's worth to visit a butcher place in the villate centre.
And of course, the cherry on that pie, is an host! Supert host!
Alican was ready to help me in any of my crazy ideas and wishes.
Thank you Bro very much!

Alican's place is amazing! It offers a great garden and it is located just a few minutes from the beach. The apartment has everything you need. His mother welcomed us with a coffee and some sweats.
I wish we could have stayed longer. ☺️
Alican’s family was very welcoming and helpful during our 1-day stay. The house was clean with all the necessary utensils and it was great spending time in their garden!

Beklediğimizin kat kat üstünde çok güzel bir ev ve çok sıcakkanlı bir ev sahipliği ile karşılaştık. Sadece evin bahçesinde oturmak bile o kadar huzur verdi ki bazı günler denize dahi gitmek istemedik. Ev, denize beş dk yürüme mesafesinde oldukça güzel bir konuma sahip. Evin dekorasyonu öyle güzel yapılmış ki hangi bahçe köşesinde oturup dinlenelim seçemedik. Bir akşam mangal köşesinde mangal yapıp gece şezlongta ışıkları kapatıp yıldızların kaymasını izlemenizi kesinlikle tavsiye ederiz. Sabah hamakta keyif yapıp ev sahibi Meral hanımın bahçesinden yeni topladığı taze domates salatalık ikramıyla uyanabilirsiniz. Asma yapraklarının altındaki köşede akşam güneşinde kahvenizi içebilirsiniz. Aklımıza takılan herhangi bir şeyde veya bir ihtiyacımızda ev sahiplerinin ilgili tavırları ile karşılaştığımız için çok şanslıyız. Sadece bir kaç günlüğüne stres atmak için geldiğimiz tatilde Meral hanımın rehberliği eşliğinde ve üst kat misafirleri ile doya doya eğlenceli bir Çilingoz turu yapmaktan çok keyif aldık.
