Evden 20dk araba mesafesindeki Çilingoz sahiline uğrayıp, boyu çok geçmeyen kumlu denizine girip bu zamana kadar yiyebileceğiniz en iyi pideyi yiyebilirsiniz :) Yazın çok keyifli olanakları olan bu evin sonbaharda da ayrı güzel olacağını düşünüp tekrar gelmeyi dört gözle bekliyoruz. Her sabah ikram ettikleri ve birlikte keyifli sohbetler eşliğinde içtiğimiz kahveleri şimdiden özledik.

description:
Istanbul is one of the oldest cities in the world. This is a vibrant, colorful, beautiful city with a rich history. You can start exploring this magnificent city with Roya apartment. In this apartment, you can feel the peace of your home and find pleasure and comfort together..
The apartment includes 2 bedrooms, 1 living room, 1 kitchen, 1 dressing room, 2 bathrooms and 2 small balconies. This is about 100 sqm. The apartment is located in Taksim which is the most popular district of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
All the comments that I have read before (check the dates) were accurate and true. If I wanna just put the matters into pros & cons, and add some of my own experience, I will write it this way:
Pros:
- No.1 is the Host, Übeydollah. If only one thing of this apartment shall shine out it is its host, Übeydollah. He is truly a super host, extremely kind and helpful well beyond what one expects from an Airbnb host; with matters even unrelated to the apartment. I believe he was the one who made our stay so memorable.
- It is located 5 min walk from the Taksim square area, which at least in the summertime has a very lively nightlife with many restaurants and bars as well as a very long and nice shopping street and shopping center located in the Istiklal street. I suggest visiting that street before taking the hassle of going to other distant shopping malls.
- It is a very nice and comfy apartment that can even accommodate a large family of 8 people. The bedrooms are separated from the living room with a corridor, so you can separate people who snore! from the rest by living them sleeping in the living room ;)
- Three fully function and string ACs makes the stay really convenient even in Istanbul's hot summer
- The washing machine and the strong tumble dryer is a big plus especially if you wanna stay for longer than few days, so you can wash and dry your laundry quite convenient and fast
- Lots of space for your luggage and clothes, as there is a walking closet that can be used also for the dressing room.
- Big TV with Netflix, Spotify, and YouTube connection. Also, you can cast from your mobile phone or tablet. That makes it easier to stay at home for those who don't really fill to go out, or when you wanna just chill out and drink at home.
- The sofa beds are firm and comfy. I slept on them for a week and even with a history of backache that I have, I did feel comfortable.
- Two French balconies make it easy for smokers to just go out and smoke without the need to go out of the building. Just be aware, the balconies are only French balconies.
Cons:
- The apartment is located on the 5th floor, which gives a very nice view of the city, but unfortunately, it does not have an elevator. This, of course, is common for most of the apartments located in that area as it is Istanbul central area with the old urban context, but this may make it hard for people with painful knees and feet (like my parents ) or with heavy luggage. Nevertheless, Übeydollah was extremely helpful with our luggage, and although my parents had 3 pieces of extremely heavy luggage of ca. 30kg, he did not let them or me pick even one of them.
- The 2nd bathroom currently is not a fully functional bathroom as it does not have a washing basin. However, as just toilet and shower, it is OK and it can help a large family not having a long queue in the morning for bathroom or shower or when they wanna get ready to go out for a party night! But that may be a bit hard for a group of people who are not comfortable with each other, as the main bathroom is located in the master bedroom, where there is a washing basin that can be used for brushing teeth or shaving or washing hands. So, people who stay in the master bedroom shall be ok with other people jumping into their room to shave or brush their teeth or even washing their hands, although you can wash your hands in the kitchen washing basin as there was also a liquid soap there.
- I did not see Ski-in/Out possibilities, the safe, the crib, baby safety gates, dedicated workspace, and the pocket wifi. So if any of those are important for you, you may wanna double confirm it with the host beforehand. I also did not have a car so no need to check the parking spaces, but the neighborhood streets were very tight in terms of parking space. So if you are planning to come by car make sure you double confirm with the host where you are going to park, as I guess you probably need indoor parking somewhere, otherwise street parking seems extremely hard to find.

Ubeydullah’s place was immaculate! Extremely clean and exactly like the pictures! Short walk to all the action in Taksim Square and Istiklal street! Ubeydullah was very responsive and helpful with anything and everything we needed and accommodated us with transportation to and from the airport. Highly recommend this spot for a stay in Istanbul as it is centrally located, extremely comfortable and private. Plus you can’t beat the price for what you get! 10/10 recommend

For a first-time visit to Istanbul we found this home to be a perfect location to get around and stay outside of the intense tourism of other areas of the city. Solid, simple and what we needed. Beds were comfortable, the shower water flow was strong, and we really appreciated that the host installed a new washing machine within a day of our arrival. We bought some olive oil, coffee and a wine opener to round out what was already available in the kitchen. The kitchen and living room were very bright, warm and sunny in the mornings. The nearby mosque delivers a loud, early wakeup with the call to prayers, but that's part of the Istanbul experience. The neighborhood was otherwise quiet and felt safe with nearby groceries, take out, and kittens (!). The location is a few minutes from a hub for buses, taxis, and metro. While there are trendier neighborhoods, we appreciated the quality/value of the apartment.

We stayed in the apartment for 13 days and we really liked it a lot. You have there everything you need. The living room is really big with three couches and really comfortable. The kitchen is quite close and well equipped with dishwasher, gas cooking, fridge, electric kettle and coffee filter machine, etc. A really good thing is a special water supply for drinking water.
The bed rooms are at the other end of the flat and the mattresses are quite good. We did not have any back pain after sleeping, although we are quite sensible for that. The apartment has also a separate toilet in addition to the fully equipped bath room which is quite nice, when more people are in the flat.
The apartment is at the forth floor which was a surprise. However, the landlord was really friendly and helped a lot for transporting our luggage up- and downstairs. In general, he was really helpful and we could contact him all time in case of questions. He also provided the Istanbul-card for public transport and helped with the small problems we have had with one of them.
The apartment is really close to Taksim square - not more than 5 minutes to walk. There, is a Metro station which gives access to all directions of public transport.
So, we really can recommend this apartment for a longer stay.

Amazing value for Istanbul! Walking distance to Taksim Square, where it is literally 24/7 (I got a haircut at 2am) but removed enough from the noise. 4th floor walkup, but the views and breeze are worth it! The apartment is bright, incredibly clean, and has enough amenities for the most comfortable stays.
Ubeydullah is incredibly responsive and communicative, friendly, and warm - he brought us a delicious gift for us to enjoy as a thank you. Regardless of the time of day, he was able to fix a minor issue within an hour, and get us a transport service a few hours before departure (we had 4 big luggages), as well as offer to get a dinner reservation for us a few hours before we arrived.
All in all, I would not hesitate to stay here again over any hotel in the area - Ubeydullah made sure of that, and he will be my go to person when I come back to Istanbul!

description:
My place is in Ataşehir. You can reach my place by taking a bus or taxi from Istanbul Airport on the European side or Sabiha Gökçen Airport on the Asian side. You can take a taxi, bus and minibus to the historical and touristic places of Istanbul in front of my house. Metro and metrobus are 15 minutes away by bus. It is an ideal place for couples, solo adventurers and business travelers.
Facilities :
Internet : 24Mbps
Air conditioning
Outdoor-Indoor Swimming pool
Turkish bath
Sauna
Gym

reviews.text:
First of all - very friendly, polite and hospitality host and was always in touch!
Apartment was new, pretty clean and tidy. All you need for 2-3 person comfortable visit for short-length staying.
Amazing view from apartment & unforgettable view from observation deck at 32 floor in the same building (free entrance 24/7)
You also had everything you need (and a little bit more) for your trip near by: carrefour supermarket at entrance, restaurant with simply food at 1 floor (meat plate highly recommended) and free public swimming pool!
10-15 minutes by foot to Yenisahra metro station
15-20 minutes by taxi to Kadikoy

This was one of my most enjoyable trips to Istanbul. The communication with Serdar and Oya was fantastic before arrival. Oya speaks English and was very very helpful and accommodating. Check in was fantastic and smooth, the flat was spotless and everything worked. The views at night were great, the beds very comfortable and the towels were soft!!
The location is easy to get out of and there is a supermarket just downstairs! The staff at the reception were very helpful too. I recommend this home away from home to anyone visiting Istanbul.
Thank you Oya and Serdar for making our stay special.

Beautiful & clean spacious apartment with all essentials included
A very lovely place and I loved the decor. The host was very helpful . The place is as described and looks even better in person. I will consider visiting again if I am ever back in town!

We had a great time at Serdar’s place. It was clean and everything we needed was around the corner. Serdar and his wife are really helpful for and made sure we were picked up and brought back to the airport. The metro to the city centre is at walking distance and there is a 24 hour store outside the building. At about 5 to 10 minutes walking distance there is an area where there are restaurants an some shops.

I really enjoyed panoramic view of the city through out the windows.There are all cooking equipments. Design of the residence is so comfortable,clean and well organized. Furnitures, sheets and towels are all new.There is a supermarket just under the residence and also a restaurant in it. Host was so nice and helpfull. I would like to thank you to the host for quick turns. All hygiene products were left for me. I will definitely prefer again to stay at the same residence.

description:
Central located 15 min walking distance to istiklal caddesi (the big street starting from Taksim down to Galata Tower)
Sheraton hotel is just across the street

The apartment has a PS4 for gaming and a projector for cinema feeling right at home.

French balcony ( for smoking)

And a luxury new bathtub where you can relax at the end of a day :)

Delivery service and taxis are easy to get as it is right in the middle of Istanbul. Small markets right around.

reviews.text: Asena is a wonderful and caring Airbnb host, and it's clear she wants the very best for her guests. I can see why she has such positive reviews here. The apartment is sparkling clean, spacious, fresh, with a stylish open layout and having all amenities for a comfortable stay. Great bed, very comfortable couch. And ohhhhh how lovely . . . that bathtub nook in the living room (has inspired me to do the same)!! Great kitchen for cooking if needed. Asena's apartment is conveniently located near all the central landmarks, sights, cafes, restaurants of Istanbul, but nicely away from all the tourist crowds. It's an up and coming area with plenty of locals . . . I enjoyed the authenticity of this neighbourhood, and the relative sanctuary within the apartment. I'm a light sleeper so at times was a little bothered by late night traffic and general goings–on, but to be fair this is a big busy city with a lot happening, and it's a small price to pay for such a nice place. Thank you Asena!!

A wonderful apartment in an absolutely fabulous neighborhood with restaurants and shops and everything you need in walking distance. Very close to Galata Tower and the harbor. Everything is comfortable and clean for a perfect stay. Asena is always very quick to respond and simply lovely. I would stay again in a heartbeat! 5 stars! Highly recommend!

Asena is the best host I’ve ever met, and I’ve traveled a lot. She’s very helpful, kind, and her apartment is amazing inside to very little details. Kitchen is great for someone who likes to cook. All tools you may need as well as variety of spices and sauces. Fridge had water bottles, milk, and a full pack of eggs!!! I liked little touches like paintings, guitar, and of course projector and PlayStation! Staying in this apartment was a whole experience.
The only downside is the neighbourhood is a bit rough and noisy, many small auto repair shops, and not so fancy looking cafes, so not much to do around unless you walk uphill to Taksim square which takes about 30 minutes and is a good cardio because incline is quite steep. But I think it’s the common theme on the south of European side and my fault for not having the right expectations.
Overall, I had a great stay thanks to Arsena’s hospitality and the quality of the apartment.

Asena is an amazing host. She was very responsive and ensured everything was fine. She even went above and beyond and had a full bag of fruits and snacks delivered to me. The unit is great, very cosy and clean. Walking distance to Taksim etc. Can highly recommend to anyone visiting Istanbul!

one of the best airbnbs I've stayed in for a long time. will definitely stay here next time I'm in Istanbul. it was so well maintained and above the top amenities. full kitchen. comfortable bed. host was also great to communicate with. without a doubt, stay here!

description: Apartment in wooden house for a crowded group of friends/family >10 persons! Centrally located, just steps from Istiklal in Taksim/Pera. Comfortable, clean, gorgeous. 3double bedrooms, 2 lounges, 2kitchens, 3bathrooms. Ground and basement floors + 2nd&3rd Floor. Free WiFi

reviews.text:
The location is great, within a walking distance to bus and metro station, galata tower, istiklal street and taksim square. Taxis are also everywhere if you stay here. Plenty of mini market nearby for groceries shopping.
The house is equipped with fully functional kitchen, bedrooms are so comfy. Loved the hardwood flooring on each floor.
Loved the personal touch decorated by the host.

we stayed at Miko's for a week. it was a nice stay and we really felt like living as local people in Istanbul. The house is located not so far from Istiqlal avenue, about 5 minutes walking and you can easily find anything there, like: fashion shops, souvenir shops? ice cream, cafes, restaurant, etc. We rent an entire house, it comes with a double bedroom, a single bedroom, a bathroom and a kitchen at first floor, then at second floor is 2 double bedroom and a big bathroom , while third floor is an attic where you can find a dining table, a kitchen, a small single bed and couch for relaxing.e if you visit during summer there is no aircon or fan provided, however you can sleep with the window open. its quite nice and cooling, but there will be some noises. there is no washing machine but miko help us with the laundry everytime we need. nearby about 1 minutr walking you will find small shops where you can buy drinks, snack and fruits. all in all it was a nice stay at miko's.

Our group of ten greatly enjoyed our stay at Miko and his wife’s place. It was a fun space in a great location very near Istikal street with so many fun places to eat and shop. They were very helpful and quick to respond to questions including arranging transport from the airport. The top floor was a great open area for hanging out, but it did get quite warm when the weather was hot. We would return again for sure.

We had a wonderful stay with 7 people in Miko's apartment. The location was perfect, with nice restaurants and shopping streets around the corner. Miko arranged for a car to pick us up from the two airports on which we arrived and bring us to the apartment.

The apartment has all basic needs but the upper living space was a bit small for some of us, not everybody could stand up straight. However we had a lot of fun in this room as we played card games and had breakfast together. With some minor adjustments, the apartment could be made more comfortable, for example lights and some furniture need fixing.

Every day we took trips in Istanbul, we either walked, took the tram or took the ferry. The apartment is situated at a very good location to get to know Istanbul. Overall, our stay was very pleasant.

We are happy that found your house! Awesome view on the roof, very cozy rooms and great location!!!
Very clean house in the quite district but near center!
Miko is a good owner, he gave us full information about the house and nearby points, it was very useful!

description: It is a room in a boutique hotel that can comfortably accommodate 3 people with 1 double bed and 1 single bed. We have 24/7 check-in and reception services.

reviews.text: Good for the price, time and 3 beds. But photos are from 2 years ago.
Otelin konumu mukemmel. Rihtima 1 dk, altiyola 5 dk mesafede. Giris- cikis sorunsuz, temiz ve rahat bir otel. Tavsiye ederim.
Great location, good price, reasonable comfort
Great location, very reasonably priced and clean. Staying here was a great experience overall.

The stay was great. Very friendly service. The rooms were clean. Shower was good with warm water and pressure.
Con!:
- There was a very bad cigarette smell. When we entered the room the smell was disgusting. We had te open de windows fully for 6-8 hours and left for the city to discover. When we came back the smell was less but still noticeable.
I wish I could rate higher but the smell was just to much for me to rate it higher.

description:
A sea-view roof duplex in a building with a garden on one of Büyükada's quietest streets.
15 minutes on foot from the pier, 5 minutes by car.
On the island's walking path, 500 m from the Greek Orphanage.
For families and groups of friends.
Not suitable for crowded and noisy events.
We kindly request that you do not smoke outside the balcony-terrace and that you do not throw cigarette butts in the garden.
We do not accept guests except those whose ID information is provided.
Those under the age of 18 can be accommodated with their families.

reviews.text:
Aba is the most perfect host you can ever imagine and the apartment is every bit as described in the presentation.
It is a perfect place to get some fresh and really clean air outside Istanbul and to explore the beauty of Buyukada and the other Princes’ Islands. Or just to enjoy the magnificient view. You can even spot Hagia Sophia from the two really spacy balconies.
When using busses and taxis on the islands, make sure your Istanbul Kart is charged. A bus ride is TL 27 per Person (Oct 22), a taxi ride from the taxi station downwtown up to Aba’s apartment is about TL 60 (which is the more comfortable and even cheaper option when travelling in a group of three … well do the math 😁).

Aba Bey'in misafirperverliğini takdir ettik. Çok ilgili ve hoşsohbet bir ev sahibi. Telefonla her an ulaşılabilir. Girişte şık bir hoş geldiniz paketi hazırlamıştı. Tatilimiz boyunca rahat etmemiz için elinden geleni yaptı. Adaya yeniyseniz sorun değil, özel notlarla ve önerilerle bir ada haritası da hazırlamış Aba Bey.
Ev iskeleye maksimum on dakikalık yürüme mesafesinde. Ayrıca IETT araçlarıyla birkaç dakikada ulaşmak mümkün. Evde ihtiyacınız olacak her şey düşünülmüş. Mutfak tam donanımlı, bulaşık makinesi var, çay kahve, yemeklik ekipmanlar ve malzemeler bile. Biz yemeklerimizi deniz manzarasına karşı evde yemeyi tercih ettik. Bazı yemekleri kendimiz hazırladık. Banyoda çamaşır makinesi mevcut, ayrıca evin bütünü gibi banyo da çok temiz ve şık. Aba Bey'in mimar eşi evi dizayn etmiş, bayıldık. Kutu oyunlarından kitaplığa, havlu, yorgan ve battaniyelere kadar her şey mevcut ve temiz. Piyano çalmayı biliyorsanız kaçırmayın :) Salonda bir piyano ve müzik seti de mevcut. Gönül rahatlığıyla kalabilirsiniz.
We appreciate Aba's hospitality. He is very caring and a sociable host. He can be reached at any time by phone. He welcomed us with an elegant pack at the entrance. He did his best to make us comfortable during our holiday. If you are new to the ısland it's fine, he had prepared an ısland map with special notes and suggestions.
The house is a max ten-minute walk from the pier. It is also possible to reach in a few minutes with IETT vehicles. Everything you need at home has been thought of. The kitchen is fully equipped, there is a dishwasher, coffee, tea, and equipment, even ingredients for preparing food. We preferred to eat at home against the sea view. We prepared some of our meals ourselves. There is a washing machine in the bathroom, and the bathroom, like the whole house, is very clean and stylish. We were told that Aba's architect wife designed the house, it is breathtaking. Everything from board games to bookshelves, towels, duvets, and blankets is available and clean. If you know how to play the piano, do not miss it :) There is one in the living room along with a music player. You can stay there with peace of mind.

Aba was the perfect host. He made us feel at home and was very responsive. The location is wonderful with beautiful views of the sea from all windows. The place was clean and comfortable. We especially enjoyed watching sunsets from the top balcony. I was working remotely and had adequate wifi without any issues. We very much appreciated the welcome treats and coffee. We highly recommend this host and location.

Evimiz çok temiz ve tam olarak fotoğraflarda gördüğümüz gibiydi. Hiçbir eksiği yoktu, ihtiyacımız olan her şey evde bulunuyordu. Manzara çok güzeldi. Evin konumu hem merkezi hem de kalabalıktan uzaktı böylece Bayram süresince hem dinlendik hem de adayı rahatlıkla gezme fırsatı bulduk. Ev sahibi Aba Bey her şeyi düşünmüştü. Bizi çok güzel ikramlarla karşıladı ve her gün herhangi bir ihtiyacımız olup olmadığını sordu. Tekrar gelmeyi düşündüğümüz bir ev olarak anılarımızda yer etti🍀Aba Bey’e ve eşine bu güzel konaklama için teşekkür ederiz.

We were spending 10 days here with our child and our parents.
Let's start with the fact, that Aba is an amazing host, who was so helpful to us on so many occasions: whether while preparing our trip, or with his Kindly prepped starter pack of necessities for the first day, traveling tips around the Island and to Istanbul itself.
The apartment is very clean and Aba has all you can think you need in the house: from cleaning supplies, towels, tape, lint roller, band aids to all kinds of plates, bowls, frying pans etc.
It has three balconies, one of which is an actual terrace with a big table and BBQ.
The view is incredible. You can see the sea in three (!!!) directions.
It's an island with hills. So you will have to walk up the hill from time to time, which is not dramatic at all, you will just burn some calories of your extra Köfte ;)
Sleeping with opened windows was very pleasant and was possible due to the mosquito nets provided. So no insect bothered us ever.
The island itself is lovely. You can go for a walk around the pine forest, visit couple of interesting landmarks or take a ride around with a fun little electrobus.
People are friendly, fish is tasty.
Going to Istanbul center isn't a problem, with the ferries. Ferry ride yet long is indeed pleasant: fresh breeze, Turkish tea and coffee to buy cheaply on board.
From all the heart we can definitely recommend you to stay at Aba's flat.

description: Welcome to VNG Property's brand new modern unit in the heart of prime Nisantasi! Close to all the tastiest restaurants and cafes and all the fanciest trendiest shops! This two bed, one bath is situated on the second floor w/ elevator and is walking distance to all transportation links. The perfect home away from home! We invite you to come stay with us! Comes w/ Wifi, Netflix, all new white appliances and a fully fitted kitchen!

reviews.text: Exceeded my expectations. My family and I absolutely loved the place, the whole place was spotless, meticulously clean including the bathroom which is always welcome. Spot on description looked exactly the same as the photographs. Very comfortable, plenty of seating a television which was great for watching the football in the evening even though we were out for most of the day and comfortable beds. We were three in number so the apartment was perfect for our needs. It was an absolute pleasure staying at this residence and VNG have done themselves proud. I would like to make a suggestion please, it would be brilliant if a wall clock could be placed on the wall above the television, just makes a life a little more convenient. VNG thank you very much I shall most certainly keep your properties in mind should i make any future visits to Türkiye.

brand new apartment, very spacious with modern and new furniture. this is a very comfortable place managed by a company like a hotel apartment. we had a great stay.
the neighborhood is central next to lots of cafes and restaurants. the building has an elevator and internet works really well.

Great apartment in great location, close to all cafes and restaurants. The house is cozy and has everything we needed. Very clean. It was our second stay in the same house, so we knew what to expect. :-)
We appreciate the communication with the host, cleanliness and how pictures were matching the reality fully!

The place was totally same as the pictures. It is modern, well designed flat. Clean and cozy place. It is center of the Nisantasi. You can walk most attractive places around this area. Host was always responded immediately. I will definitely stay again.

What an incredible find in the heart of Nisantasi. Quiet yet in a bustling street full of very chic cool restaurants and coffee shops, this little gem was true to its words and pictures. Modern, very clean with a great team at VNG that manage the property and the best location anyone could ask for! I absolutely loved my stay at nisantasi 8 and I extended my trip twice whilst staying there! Thanks so much for a perfect stay and I look forward to the next!

description:
This is a cozy private room with private bathroom, located in the quiet part of Sultanahmet area. You can easily reach the main square within 5-6 mins on foot, and have the chance to visit all the major attractions of the Old City.
there is reception 24/7 .

reviews.text: Our stay was great! The people working in the hotel are very nice. Even the cleaning ladies can speak some English, so the communication was not a problem at all. In the end, we were even allowed to leave our luggage at the front desk and leave a small container of food in the kitchen upstairs. Great value for the price!

Deniz Houses apartment is a GREAT place to stay in Istanbul and I insist on it.
Location is ideal if you want to do sightseeings, Hagia Sophia mosque, Blue mosque and grand Bazaar are very near to the hotel. Plus, the room are quiet, very clean and well equiped with slippers, tea, a bottle of water and wifi. I really recommend you stay there because it's cheap and it's worth it! The hotel staff would help you and even find you a "taksi" if needed, they are friendly.

Alihan's place was much better than I expected and perfect for a solo traveler. It's essentially a hotel, but your private room has everything you need. I was pleasantly surprised to have my own private terrace/balcony with a view of the water - can't beat that. The rooftop terrace has extraordinary views and as a photographer/filmmaker, I appreciated taking photos/video from the roof. The staff was kind and helpful. My flight was early in the morning, so I was going to miss their complimentary breakfast. The staff was kind enough to bring me a plate of delicious goods the night prior so I would have it as a snack in the morning. Great hospitality! The space is a short walk to the famous Blue mosque, close to major restaurants and parks, and very close to the local bazaar/market place. Alihan and the hotel were able to arrange car service to and from Istanbul Airport. I definitely plan to come back and stay again! Thank you Alihan!
Alihan’s place is centrally located, walking distance to attractions, restaurants & mini market. Room is clean and as described, good value for money indeed.

Stayed in Deniz House for 4 nights. everything was as expected and described. Nice place in a quiet safe neighborhood with easy access to historical places and public transportation. You can take a walk to most places.
There's a room service that cleans your room everyday and it's awesome. And the breakfast at the rooftop is an amazing start for your day.
Staff were very nice and helpful. They will help you schedule plan your day trips better.
Best place for individuals and groups up to 4 who seek a clean, affordable and hassle free place.
Will be my first choice in Istanbul. Highly recommended

description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the hearth of Istanbul's historic peninsula?

This booking offers fully equipped design apartment across partial Bosphorus (sea) view. Located right on the the famous Istiklal Street, you will find historic places, prestigious museums, night life, public transits and more just beside you.

With a restaurant cooking delicious meals downstairs, daily cleaning service and assistance for all kinds of concierge needs, this apartment is to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text:
A beautiful apartment. Spacious, clean, great location. Despite Istiklal being packed with shoppers, this space is quiet and peaceful (as it faces away from the street).
Location on lower part of Istiklal also worked well for us, as it is a bit more peaceful than spaces closer to Taksim.
At night you might hear the restaurant downstairs pack up chairs - but it didn’t bother us too much.
If you want to experience Istiklal, this is the place for you. Great and responsive hosts.
Thanks!

The flat was really amazing, in a very good location and the service was exceptional. Whenever we needed anything from the host, they’d respond right away and help us with whatever they can. I also loved the cleaning service and loved the ease of communication.

Very convenient apartment, with very good amenities: washer with built-in dryer, dishwasher, Smart TV (we used our Netflix account), convenient and large bed, as well as couch. The host is great and communicates very well and helped us with everything we needed. Convenient smart door lock. The apartment is located on Istiklal street which was a surprise for us when we moved in, however, for our apt the windows were looking at the back yard so there was no noise from the street.

Good location. It’s important to mention that even it has windows faced to the backyard it is still apt in a building on the busiest street of Istanbul. You still will get a bit of noise.
The room is clean, fresh furnitured and has simple checkin. Great experience.
Very nice appartment. Clean, cozy and great location

description: Spacious elegance for two near Taksim Square: Discover a spacious and stylish apartment near Taksim Square,the heart of modern Istanbul.Boasting an entire studio for yourself, this elegant space accommodates 2 guests and offers a serene escape amidst the dynamic energy of the city. Step into a thoughtfully designed studio that seamlessly blends elegance with functionality.The spacious layout creates an atmosphere of comfort and sophistication,ensuring a delightful stay in the heart of the city.

reviews.text:
1 STAR ONLY
Check-in and check-out policy is unreasonable (Check-in at 6 PM, check-out at 12 noon).
• The place is smaller than it appears in photos.
• Major issue with the bathroom:
• Extremely small toilet—impossible for tall or larger people.
• Had to use public toilets due to limited space.
•
Heating issues:
• No built-in heating system.
• Only one air conditioner in the kitchen, which doesn’t effectively heat the bedroom.
• Stayed during winter (9°C) and had to sleep in all my clothes due to the cold.
• Poor soundproofing and door sealing:
• Balcony door lets in noise and cold air, worsening the discomfort.
Location is convenient for transportation, but:
• Situated on a steep downhill slope.
• Requires climbing a large staircase, making it unsuitable for kids or elderly guests.
Host communication issues:
• Host didn’t respond when I reported a problem.
• Only responded to remind me about check-out time.
Also Experienced a water cut 🥲

Great location off the main street in a nice little neighborhood. Tons of restaurants and shops and grocery in walking distance. The apartment is very comfortable and has a nice little balcony to chill on as well as a side sitting room, or tea room. Not sure exactly what it is but it's nice. The host is communicative and friendly and made check-in / check-out super easy. I was also working during my stay there and has no problems with the Wifi including video calls. Next time i'm in Istanbul I'll definitely stay in this neighborhood - and if possible book the same location. Thanks!

We stayed here on September 2023. The host was responsible and responded to every message in less than an hour. The place was perfectly clean and equipped as the host described, completely matched with the photos. Things you should know are the place is quite small, especially the bathroom. The location is just a 4-minute walk to Taksim Square however you should consider the deep steep from Taksim to the apartment. Overall we had a great stay and will come back soon.

Awesome apartment! My husband and I enjoyed staying here for 2 weeks.
First of all, it was ideally clear. It was even hard to believe that someone lived here before us!
Good equipped, stylish, with an eye on details. All you need for leaving (and taking nice photos as well :) There also were some welcome snacks, toiletries (enough for 2 adults for 2 week), and household items.
Convenient location. Close to Taxim (and public transport), but located on a calm, quiet street. It was easy to find the building.
Our host (co-host) was Missy. She's kind and ready to help, we had no problems.
Probably two potential drawbacks of this apartment I have to mention: second floor without an elevator and quite a tiny bathroom (especially toilet space). But if you have no heavy suitcases or special health conditions, it would not be a problem.
To sum up, I would highly recommend this apartment! Missy and Neslihan, thank you very much!

The Airbnb was great and located in a prime location in Istanbul, with plenty of eateries and amenities nearby. The host was superb with communication and provided excellent hospitality throughout my stay. She was very polite, helpful, and responsive.
One small thing to keep in mind for future guests is that the property requires walking up a fairly steep slope and using a spiral staircase. It wasn’t an issue for me but guests travelling with larger or heavier luggage may find it a little challenging. I would say the place is particularly convenient for travellers with backpacks or lighter luggage.
Overall, I had a lovely stay and really appreciated the host’s warm hospitality.

description:
Escape the noisy hustle and bustle of central Istanbul and come relax in a lovely Bosphorus Home with a garden in prestigious Yeniköy, merely a 5-minute walk to the sea. Easy access to the rest of the city via bus, minibüs, subway and (our favorite) the sea ferry.

You'll enjoy a whole 1+1 apartment with your own bedroom, livingroom, kitchen, shower, WC, etc and access to a shared garden/patio area. Peaceful & quiet neighborhood and nice views of sea, hills, forest, skyline & the FSM bridge.

reviews.text:
Hasan's place is the best Airbnb I've ever stayed in.
I was seeking a larger space along the Bosphorous in a location that afforded greater privacy and serenity, all the while maintaining proximity to the hustle and bustle of old Istanbul. Well, Hasan's place has got all that and much, much more.
-The space: Nestled atop a hill/bluff overlooking Bosphorous and bridge alike, the living space is large, private, and extremely comfortable. Every amenity you will need, including a private outdoor garden!
Location: Quiet and wonderfully walkable neighborhood with eateries, grocery stores, cafes, and bars down the hill, a two or three minute walk, while the ferry to anywhere is a 10-15 minute walk. Dolmush, bus, and taxi accessible.
-The Views!: Bosphorus views during the day, glimmering bridge views at night. Nothing like this in old Istanbul!
-The host: What a genuine sweetheart of a man. Hasan went above and beyond to make sure my stay was perfect. And it was.
I will be back.

Excellent choice for your Istanbul visit; stay in a ritzy neighborhood along the Bosphorus Strait away from hectic and noisy Taksim / Istiklal, large comfortable apartment, fully equipped kitchen, garden with fruit trees and a great view, cool responsive host family that understands what travelers need, and just a ten-minute walk to the ferry that stops in the heart of the tourist areas Beşiktaş and Eminönü. Amazing value.

My stay at Hasan's and Seyma's place was wonderful. I had never been to Istanbul (neither Turkey) before coming to Istanbul, but Hasan and Seyma made me feel at home from the start. The apartment is quite spacious, and the area is very quiet even though it is just a 5-10mins walk from the Bosphorus with lots of cafés and restaurants. Throughout my whole stay (five weeks), Hasan was really quick to respond to any questions that I had and supported me with everything from topping up my mobile data to getting new drinking water. For this, it was really helpful that Hasan speaks perfect English.
The only thing important to bear in mind is that the touristic places like Eminönü and Beyoglu are a bit further away (roughly 45min-75min by public transport), so if that is what you are looking for, staying somewhere closer to the touristic sights might be better.
Thanks so much, Hasan and Seyma!
A secluded place with a beautiful view on Bosphorus. Takes a while to get to the metro but it's worth it, in my view. Hasan is a great host, I truly enjoyed communicating with him!

Hasan is a great host: extremely friendly, responsive, and helpful. I got to the apartment at 2 am and I could check in easily without any problems.
the apartment is very nice and spacious. The location is a bit far from the famous tourist attractions, but the beautiful neighborhood offers a rather true Istanbul experience. There are also many nice cafes and restaurants around.

description: You can enjoy this beautiful brand new apartment near Şişli, with an excellent location, in a pleasant place and close to the city center, shops, hospitals. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, washing machine, kitchen with basic appliances (fridge, stove, kettle and full kitchen utensils), dining room. Wi-Fi internet access and garage included.

reviews.text: Property is clean and check in was easy. Linen had stains on it but was easily replaced after some time. Shower corners had mould but it wasn’t too bad. Overall apartment is clean and comfortable. Price is slightly high for apartment.

There are a lot of ants in the apartment, and the bed sheets are not clean. Other than that, everything is excellent.
Car parking there also , safe place , near to the center.👍

It is a convenient place to stay at in Istanbul. 2 bedrooms, a living room and a kitchen. There are a waching machine and a dryer. There is an underground parking lot. Many stores in the nearby. 24/7 Security.

İsmail beyin evi merkezi konumda. Ev çok temiz ve modern. Eşyalar yeni. Girişte 7/24 güvenlik durmakta içiniz rahat olsun. Otoparkı mevcut. İsmail bey bütün sorularımıza hızlı ve net cevap verdi. Toplu taşımaya çok yakın. Gönül rahatlığı ile tercih edebilirsiniz. Biz çok memnun kaldık.

enjoy.

reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay in Lady Boutique hotel! this place is SUPER clean and nice, you will not find a place at this price with same high cleaning standards on the whole Adalar for sure. And the host Metin and Tatyana are very nice and friendly people, we loved our conversations, and they gave us valueble advises about the island! We wish to come back soon to this hotel :)
The room is very comfortable, everything is clean , great location. Mehmet is respectful and responsible host. I wish we could stay longer here.

Öncelikle konumu çok iyi, minibüs duraklarının hemen yanında. Mehmet Bey bizimle gayet iyi iletişim kurdu, gerekli bilgilendirmeleri sağladı, bize ada hakkında güzel tavsiyelerde bulundu (onun sayesinde çok güzel bir cafe keşfettik). Kaldığımız oda gayet rahat ve temizdi. Tek kullanımlık sabun, şampuan, içme suyu hepsi mevcuttu, kalorifer de klima da sorunsuz çalışıyordu, ısınma problemi de çekmedik. Tek sorun yan odadaki kız grubunun tüm dedikodularına hakim olmamızdı yani odalar ses geçiriyor ama vaktimizin çoğunu dışarıda geçirdiğimiz için sorun yaşamadık. Tekrar tercih etmeyi düşünüyoruz.

Our stay was very nice. The place was spotless clean. and Mehmet is a very friendly and helpful person, he welcomed us very well. The location is also great. One minor issue is that it says it has the square view, but our room looked at a backyard, which is not too bad. Price is kinda above the average. I recommend the place though.
Pretty basic but that was to be expected, maybe a little expensive but was very clean and in a great location, and was very easy to check in and out, etc.

description:
This is a cozy private room with bathroom, located in the quiet part of Sultanahmet area. You can easily reach the main square within 5-6 mins on foot, and have the chance to visit all the major attractions of the Old City.

there is a airport shuttle bus (HAVAIST) stop is only 300 meters away from the hotel.
Istanbul Airport to Sultanahmet and return .
This is the easy way from IST airport to Sultanahmet.

reviews.text: Only a couple minutes walk from old town and a great spot for the price. A private comfortable room with friendly and caring staff, Fatih is the best! Definitely recommend staying here. My only small complaint is the shower door didnt close very well and some water got onto the bathroom floor. Nothing a small towel couldn't fix. Thank you for a wonderful time in Istanbul!

I can not say it was a pleasent stay due to some external and internal issues. Mostly the place was noisy for me even you can easily hear the phone talk of a person from next room or from outside. The window of the room was blocked with the bed so you can only open quarter of it . The Ac is located just across the bed which is not functional. The personal was helpful but it doesn't help the discomfortness of the accommodation.

The room was small, but nice, I liked the furniture and decorations. The hotel is situated in good area, very close to metro and Sultanahmet square. Wi-fi wasn't fast enough for me, and in some parts of the room it was very bad connection. Anyway, I think it is good hotel for this price.

This is the best location that you can stay in within the Old City. It is just a couple blocks from the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia. You can see both from the kitchen. The price was great, the rooms are cleaned daily, and there is someone at reception 24/7 so you never need to worry about getting into the building. The top floor is the kitchen and breakfast eating room, but is open all the time and provides a wonderful balcony overlooking the sea and local life - a great place to read and relax. Lots of options for food in the area and a small market if you just need water/snacks/drinks. Definitely will be staying here again.

We spent a wonderful holiday in Naz Wooden Houze Inn. The hotel is fully consistent with the description, very clean and nice. Locations is a five minute walk from the main attractions. Turkish breakfast is include. The owner of the apartment is helpfull and friendly. Highly recommended!

description:
In the heart of Istanbul in the area of Nişantaşı.
Both the bedroom and living space are spacious and organized to keep your relaxed.
It takes just 5 minutes to reach the metro station and is a highly accessible place with all facilities available around, caffe, restaurants, shops and much more!

reviews.text:
It’s was a good location to explore the area and comfortable beds , some supplies was available
But i might misunderstand the description as it says 2 bedroom but i found out that is 1 bedroom 1 living room with sofa
We spend 1 whole day without electricity due to maintenance
Wifi not meet expectations
Shower tub was dirty
No plastic bag available to change the trash pin

The place is exactly as what's described in the post - very clean and spacious. The place feels very safe and cozy. The location is prime - it's less than 5 minutes walk from metro and bus stations and is surrounded by many great restaurants/coffee shops. Overall I'd recommend it to friends and family!

Great location in the heart of Nişantaşı and a 5 min walk to the metro. Close to lots of shopping and restaurants. Very spacious apartment and everything was as described and clean. Would definitely recommend!
Had an awesome stay. The location is central to everything. The host was exceptionally responsive and flexible. The place was clean and comfortable. Can’t wait to visit Istanbul and stay here again!

Wassim was very helpful. The location is great and close to cafes and shops. The apartment is cosy and clean. Wassim was quick to solve a small issue we had with the shower in the bath. The fridge freezer was very handy.

description:
New, stylish, cosy studio flat (45 sqmeters) near taksim sq. The region is a quiet and calm area very close to the metro, airport shuttles, attractions such as Nisantasi and Taksim.
The flat is a one year new flat and has all the equipment.

reviews.text:
This place was absolutely perfect!
The apartment is cozy, spotless, and full of natural light. It’s in a great location with very easy access to everything—public transportation, markets, cafes, and more.
The kitchen is well-equipped, the washing machine works perfectly, and the bed was super clean and comfortable. The flat is on a higher floor, has an elevator, and comes with a lovely balcony.
But the highlight of my stay? The Wi-Fi is unbelievably fast and stable—a huge plus for anyone working remotely.
And most importantly, the host Adnan is truly exceptional. Incredibly kind, always responsive, and just genuinely helpful in every way. He made everything easier and was always there whenever I needed anything. I can’t thank him enough.
Highly recommended. I would absolutely stay here again!

This place could be very nice for longer term stays if a bit of repair was undertaken, for now I think it is too expensive for the quality of amenities you receive if you plan to work from home there. That said, for a short term stay (where you do not intend to work in the apartment) its a nice choice!
Pros: It is well located for public transport, its spacious, has working a/c, consistently fast wifi, and always had hot water. The last three are not always guaranteed in Istanbul! It also had a nespresso and tea machine, a really nice touch not mentioned in listing!
Cons: The electric stove was very rusted and the pans/utensils were not very clean, the table/chairs were uncomfortable for doing any sort of serious computer work at (if you work from home), it is located directly next to an auto mechanic so it is noisy in the day time, the bedding was very limited (one sheet and two pillows, no duvet).

I felt right at home during my stay! The space was clean, peaceful, and free of clutter—exactly what I needed for a comfortable visit. The host was very responsive and made everything easy. Plus, the location is super walkable, with everything I needed just a short stroll away. Would definitely stay again!

I can highly recommend this apartment, very comfortable and in an excellent location just 10 minutes walk to Taksim metro ( Gezi Park exit) and airport bus. Bed super comfy, good air con and wifi, well stocked kitchen and responsive host. I have stayed in a few Airbnb’s in Istanbul and I would definitely stay here again

Well, The hosts are very helpful and flexible, they let us to stay after the checkout for 6 hours.
As for the place, it's near to bus station, Taksim Metro Station ( around 8-10 minutes).

description: Welcome to our spectacular penthouse with a true “Million-Dollar Old City View” — no exaggeration! From the moment you step onto the large balcony or private terrace, you’ll enjoy breathtaking 360-degree views of Istanbul’s magical skyline. Watch the sunrise over Hagia Sophia, admire the beauty of Blue Mosque, and take in the historic charm of Topkapı Palace, along with stunning views of the Bosphorus and the entire Old City.

reviews.text:
I am going to start by saying that this is a perfect example of a perfect holiday that was made just right by staying in this amazing apartment that we felt was our home away from home. Firstly the pictures truly underestimates the beauty of the view and serenity. It is the best view in all of Istanbul… The location of this apartment is perfect it is extremely central and without the hustle and bustle around, you get to really enjoy a good nights sleep despite being so central to galataport, taksim, Karakoy and so many prime touristic spots that are only walking distance away. Not to mention the amazing restaurant options around Cihangir. Whilst you are in the apartment you get to enjoy the most beautiful view on this terrace, the apartment is clean, modern and comfortable I really loved the furniture and choice of lighting. The apartment has air conditioning and the parquet flooring was really convenient for my young girls.
The host Kemal is truly one of a kind and I have never experienced such an amazing and genuine host like Kemal! If I could create a super super host status for him I would. Kemal is extremely honest, considerate, very approachable, extremely responsive and very accommodating. He went out of his way from day one, even prior to us booking the apartment to ensure we had all the details clarified, and there was always an answer provided to any query raised. Not only was the apartment fully equipped with all the necessities Kemal went an extra mile to share all locations of groceries and actually helped us order a few things that we needed. Kemal was super attentative, extremely responsive and always went above and beyond to ensure we had a comfortable stay.
During our stay Kemal would also share links to restaurants/ places when I asked for guidance and shared so many recommendations that really made our trip worthwhile!
This vacation was with my two daughters (1 and 4 year old) and my parents (both over 60) and initially we were worried about the stairs… this was actually one of the most exciting parts of our trip and both my parents and 4 year old daughter thoroughly enjoyed it and it kept us active. Not to mention that Kemal did arrange for his relative to help us with our luggage which was extremely thoughtful. He also ensured we had access to Netflix for the girls.
Thank you Kemal for making this an exceptional stay for us and for being super informative, extremely genuine, and always accessible. I will most definitely be back and staying in this place every time I am in Istanbul with my family. My parents and daughters didn’t want to leave and we loved every moment spent in this beautiful place.

Kemal made arrangements for his family to meet us at check-in and assist with luggage up 4 flights of stairs. Kemal was available to help on departure with same. Honestly, after day 2 we were totally used to the stairs and they were no issue. And it is so worth it, the view is spectacular, it is ever changing and mesmerising. When back at the apartment we spent our whole time on the balcony. The apartment has everything you need. Great beds, great water pressure for shower, enough kitchen items for simple cooking. Clean, spacious and comfortable. Easy rubbish disposal at front door. Fantastic neighbourhood, although more stairs to climb up to main social area of the suburb, there are bars, restuarants, supermarkets within 10 mins walk .5-6 min walk down to Galataport for Bosphorus cruise, or tram to old city. Half hour walk to Taksim square. Communication with Kemal was easy and instant. Thank you Kemal - loved our stay -5 stars.

When we first stumbled upon this penthouse on Airbnb, it seemed almost too good to be true. We thought there was a catch! Everything was as perfect as it seemed online. The apartment has an amazing view which is more than a million dollar. You can see all old peninsula, islands, bosphorous and maiden tower. It is also close to all attractions metro, ferry and tram lines. The neighborhood is surrounded by too many restaurants and cafes. Kemal is the most thoughtful, fun host. He provided us with all the information we needed and showed us around the area. The apartment is really comfortable. The kitchen contains everything you need. The bed is comfortable and the bathroom and terraces are clean and light. The location was incredible. Kemal had excellent restaurant recommendations and was of great help. He went way beyond to make our stay comfortable and memorable. Thanks Kemal and a Million Dollar View Apartment for such a wonderful time! We will be back.

Stunning Bosphorus Views in a Perfect Galata Location
Kemal communicated quickly — we had very few questions throughout our stay. The apartment is exactly as described, with a large patio that became the best hangout spot of our entire trip. Pictures simply do not do the view justice. Watching the constant boat activity on the Bosphorus, especially in the evening after the city noises quieted down, was unforgettable. Walk one block up, stairs, to a lively street of cafes that transforms into a vibrant pub scene in the evening. Or head three blocks straight down the stairs to Galata Port, a new entertainment zone with shops and restaurants right on the Bosphorus — also where you'll catch the tram or buses. We frequently used Uber since Istanbul is VERY hilly.
The apartment itself is worth the splurge. We saved a considerable amount by not paying for tourist spots. One important note: there are four flights — 87 steps — to reach the apartment.

This Airbnb truly felt like a home away from home. The apartment was clean, spacious, quiet, and incredibly comfortable. I honestly had some of the best sleep of my life there.
The location was excellent, close to a Migros grocery store, the wonderful Susam Cafe for breakfast or dinner, and within walking distance of the tram, making it easy to explore Istanbul.
The balcony view of the Bosphorus will absolutely take your breath away.
Most importantly, the host was attentive, kind, and made sure every need was met throughout my stay. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul.

description: Luxury 2+1 apartment in premium residence. Double Jacuzzi, 2 bathrooms, up to 6 people. Nişantaşı's best location. 24/7 security.

reviews.text:
this was one of the best places we have stayed. It was technically a hotel apartment with 24_7 front desk that was not only present but also very helpful and accommodated our need even at 2am. they were extremely helpful and friendly and always offered or help. they provided transportation to the airport as well as assistance with restaurant reservation. the place was spotless, and they even offered house cleaning every 3 days.
my only issue was that the 2 bedroom was technically a 1 bedroom & suit combined. that meant the living room & and kitchen was very small for eating or hanging out for 6 people. Also the kitchen was very small and not equipped for cooking. We could only make breakfast or light dinner. however, they were nice enough to give us some extra pots. overall, the place is a bit overpriced, in my opinion.

We enjoyed staying at this place a lot. We originally booked two suits, then added a third one, but unfortunately, there was an issue with the final suit and we had to find another accommodation for our friends. Can was super helpful and responsive. He was there to greet us when we arrived, showed us what we needed to know about the building. One of the upsides to this location was the elevator, because if you've been to Istanbul before, then you know that most buildings are older, without an elevator.
The only concern that we had, which had nothing to do with the host, was the fact that the entire building felt moist. There was a certain smell and feeling of wetness in the air, and because of that, the bedding felt moist too. But all in all, we enjoyed our time. The neighbourhood is superb, and the location is walkable to some of the best cafe, restaurants and stores.

We had a wonderful stay! The
apartment was super clean, cozy, and exactly like the photos. The area felt very safe — we even left our bags and went out for breakfast with no worries at all. The location is perfect and close to everything. It was also very quiet and peaceful, no noise at all. The host was kind and very helpful. Highly recommend and would definitely come back!

First of all lots of thanks to Can&Cemil for their help
The apartment location is great; it's my first time renting in Nishantshi and it won't be the last; it was a great experience truly
active surroundings; lots of things to do and lots of shops restaurants and cafes to go to
There was a bakery, supermarket, and pharmacy within walkable distance
I rented the apartment on the 4th floor
It felt like home the furniture and place were so cozy and clean
The bathroom was clean and felt like it had never been used, there was hot water as well
A bad situation happened to us but when contacting the hosts its been resolved immediately with a very fast response
If they can improve something they may do the housekeeping daily or day by day and offer more blankets
I would truly recommend renting at their place

Great little micro apartment in the heart of a busy neighborhood so close to anything you might need. The host was really helpful - I arrived super late from a delayed flight at 2am and he was there to meet me for a smooth checkin. He went above and beyond to help with laundry and anything I asked about.
Pro- host, neighborhood, clean & cute place with big tub, great a/c, safe & convenient.
Con-
I would mention that it is a little noisey with upstairs Neighbour’s and hallway plus the mosque prayer time is very audible. If you are a solid sleeper it won’t bother you.

description:
The house is located in one of the most popular areas of the city. You’ll be enjoying the chic city center directly when you leave the apartment.
The apartment is on a very secure street.
The street is quiet at night and very vibrant in the daytime.
We just newly renovated and decorated the place.
The apartment has 2 bedrooms and 1 living room.
There is a sofa bed in the living room.

reviews.text: Clean and cozy apartment. New and nice furniture. Great location nearby (Osmanbey) metro station. The host allowed us for early check-in and provided complimentary biscuits and water. First floor with no elevator. The aircon is only in the living room, but cold enough to rech the two rooms.

The apartment was great, looked exactly like the photos and was clean and welcoming. It is located in a fairly quiet street off the main road. The amenities are all as listed.
The location is good, like most areas on this side of Istanbul it is central to most places. There are many good cafes, clothing stores and restaurants close by.
Baris and Çisel are both very lovely. Çisel was always very quick to respond to any questions and very helpful in all situations. We had a difficult situation to solve and Çisel went out of her way to help us by making phone calls etc. I’d highly recommend this place to anyone!

Helpful and friendly host, clean big place, great location, great value, and peaceful location .The kitchen is a little small and if you are planning on cooking a lot you may want to make sure you have the cookware you need with the host.

The apartment was tidy and clean. Everything was as described in the list of details. It was very close to metro station and it was easy to reach all key places of the city. Baris and his sister Cisel were responsive and reachable. Thanks a lot to Baris and Cisel. I definitely recommend this apartment.

Baris's house is very clean and corresponds exactly to the description. I unfortunately could only spend one night in the house because a general electricity cut happened in the area of the building which was really out of control of Baris and Cisel hands to resolve the issue. They did really their best and had a very regular communication with me.
Otherwise the house is very well located, clean and very safe. Thanks Cisel and Baris for hosting me and I wished my experience could have been a bit longer to enjoy the apartment.
Best,
Sarah

description:
If you would like to rent for a short time, please send me a message. Thank you.
An adventure opportunity in the heart of Istanbul to catch the pace of this unique getaway and relax as much as we want

reviews.text:
Thanks Gozde for allowing the key handover late as we had an evening flight. The apart is per the photos, quirky and comfortable for couples. Glad of hot water and A/C. The main advantage of the apartment is the location. The area is ideal with a bus terminal serving both airports and the apart is a 5 min taxi ride away. There is also a direct metro line to Sabiha airport. Nearby inexpensive ferry port to all tourist sites and islands. Entertainment : vibrant pubs, bars, restaurants ,coffee shops and live music etc to meet all budgets. Sport: Bosphorus seafront jogging circuit , park, gymnasium equipment and nearby Fenerbahce stadium for soccer fans. Good shopping .
We hope to be back in Oct. One thing I would mention, not a criticism but a suggestion, it would have been nice to have met our host just for a 5 min chat rather than the fleeting but understandable key handover as late check in ,because from photos in the apart she seems a well travelled and interesting person. Thx G

Gözde is no doubt an interesting girl living an interesting life and her apartment reflects that.
In the apartment: -normal internet, -clean, -good pressure and warm water, -comfortable mattress, -not hot in summer, -quiet and excellent location.
Of the minuses: -bad internet in the bedroom and perhaps too many things of the hostess))), half of our things were forced to stay in the suitcase.
The apartment is as in the photos, I recommend.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at an Airbnb hosted by Gözde and it was a great experience. The location was perfect - centrally located and easy to access all the amenities of the city. The flat itself was surprisingly quiet, despite being in the heart of the city.
Gözde is an incredibly welcoming and kind person who truly takes care of her guests. She went out of her way to make sure I had everything I needed and was comfortable during my stay. Her warm hospitality really made my stay even more enjoyable.
The flat was a bit overfilled with things, but it was also well maintained and very comfortable. Despite the abundance of items, the space was very clean and organized. I had everything I needed for a comfortable stay, including all the necessary amenities.
Overall, I would highly recommend staying at Gözde's Airbnb. The location is fantastic, the flat is comfortable and well maintained, and Gözde is an exceptional host who truly cares about her guests. Thank you

Location.
You can get to it from Sabina airport by metro + 15 minutes walking.
Near the metro station there is ferry dock - you can get to other district or to Adalar. Riding ferry at the heat is great.
There are cafes, restaurants, bars, shops are within walking distance.
Bar streets are very crowded and noisy, but the apartment is far enough - nothing disturbs you at your sleep.
Embankment, were you can walk, is in 10 minutest on feet.
Inside.
Apartment is not huge, but not too small either. Shower cubicle is a bit cramped but wasn't a problem for us.
Host lives here, so there is a lot of her staff. No microwave, 2 air conditioners, extremely comfortable mattress.
Host.
Host answers very quick almost at any time for any question. My girlfriend got ill at Friday evening - we got through the weekend thanks to first aid kit in the apartment and Gozde told us how to get to a doctor (we did it on Monday).
Total.
It's a great place to stay at Kadikoy district.

Perfect and peaceful apartment within walking distance of cafes, restaurants, and shops in Moda. Gözde is an amazing host and made me feel right at home. Check-in was easy, and Gözde was very accommodating when I arrived on a late flight.
There’s a park right by the water only a 3 minute walk away, beautiful for sunset. Location is perfect, and the apartment itself was very clean and well decorated.
I was traveling solo and working online, and would recommend it for other digital nomads.
Great stay!!

description: Located on a side street just off Istiklal Avenue, our apartment resides within a historic building boasting over a century of heritage. Nestled on a street renowned for its tranquility, our building underwent a comprehensive renovation in 2020, rejuvenating its charm while updating all its systems

reviews.text:
As in photos.
Clean cute place. Well equipped.
Fantastic location if you can walk up or down a short stretch of steep road.
Very close to major tourist areas, restaurants and stores.
Responsive professional host.
Very cute.
Would recommend putting a longer glass separator in the shower.

Great location. Very clean apartment. Very quiet. Looks just like the photos. Apartment is a little smaller than it appears online but more than enough space and has everything you need. Pristine condition. Charming building. Very responsive host. I had to reserve it last minute and they were very responsive. For those traveling with luggage, there is a cobblestone incline that you have to walk up and down. But it is manageable. Could benefit from a floor length mirror (perhaps one propped up against the wall). There is a taxi stand a couple of blocks away near the hotels. Wonderful, clean apartment with a lot of charm. Would definitely stay there again!

Beautiful apartment in a great area. Located down a very quiet street that is only a few minutes walk from everything. Exactly as shown in pictures. Clean. The only small problem was that the wifi signal is weak most of the time, so not the best situation if you are looking to work remotely. However, cell service was good in the apartment. Regardless, would definitely stay here again. The host(s) are very friendly, responsive, and helpful. It was a great stay! Thank you!

We loved this place! Matched the pictures exactly, was incredibly clean, and in a great area. The hosts were super responsive and helpful to all of our needs and requests… answering questions almost immediately. There is a steep hill you have to go up and down to reach the place but not an issue if you’re walking. Most Ubers were willing to pick us up from the bottom, especially when we told them we had luggage. I’d totally recommend this place except if you have a rental car it’s really tricky to get in and out of the one way hill street. Lots of car parks nearby though.

Excellent location . Quiet night. Loud mornings due to children school across the apartment facing bedroom.
Clean. Bright sunlight in the morning in living / kitchen area. Short walk to train which connected you to whole city. Great internet no issues.

description:
Amazing view apart adjacent to patriarchate at center of Balat.
-10 min to Taksim Square
-15-20 min to Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar (public transportation)

-Sharing Terrace with sea view
-Private bathroom
-Washing Machine

Local experience nearby centers and tourist spots
*Comfortable private Bedroom
*Terrace
*Equipped kitchen,
* Heating

*Flexible check-in & check-out times

Terrace: Rooftop terrace with and city view only belongs to my house and my dear guests

reviews.text: A very charming area, lots to explore right outside the door. Cute cafes and restaurants within walking distance. Easy to get to other areas of Istanbul, boats and tram are nearby (10 minutes walk). Gorgeous view from the room which was clean and comfortable. Always responsive host. We were multiple times invited for tea and coffee in the kitchen upstairs.

I really liked the apartment. Bulut was always accessible and responsive so very easy to communicate. The best part of the apartment is of course the view of the Golden Horn and the location in general. It is right above the Patriarchate and very near the lively streets and all the restaurants, shops, etc. However it is relatively quiet for this city. It is also about 10 min walk to the tram, which takes you to Eminönü in 4 stops.
The kitchen is minimalistic but functional, and it was so great to have a simple breakfast or dinner watching the ships going back and forth. The bathroom is very small and takes some getting used to, but ok for a few days. The bed is quite comfortable.
The downside of the location is that it is on the hill, so quite some climb from the restaurant streets, however it is much easier to get there from the other side. Also as the streets are pedestrian, taxi drivers refused to go to the apartment and stopped on the main street.
In total, can be recommended.

A cozy and inviting apartment tucked into a cozy and convenient neighborhood just 10 minutes by scooter (20 minutes by taxi) from Sultanahmet and The Hagia Sophia. Bulut was very responsive and flexible with my requests and made sure I was comfortable throughout my stay. The bedroom has a fantastic view of the water and Galata tower and about half of Istanbul! No AC but with the with the windows wide open and the fan running it was quite comfortable at night. I’d definitely stay here again if I wanted to come back to Balat, which is a great eclectic and not-too-crowded neighborhood to work and relax in.

We really enjoyed our stay in Fener. The local neighbourhood was delightful to walk around with lots of lovely cafes and restaurants.
Public transport are close by. We used the tram, ferry and metro during our stay.
The room was comfortable with a great view. Server was very helpful and hospitable.
The kitchen and bathroom are basic but perfectly adequate.

it was a lovely apartment. i only spent two days here but found myself wishing i found it sooner.
the house is on a steep hill so if you have luggage be warned.
the host was very helpful and the family who lives in the building were very kind and hospitable. even gave me a plate of food unprompted.
the views are amazing there was a cat that came to the windowsill begging to be let in which was typical istanbul.
aircon, heating, hot water, linen, towels, wifi, smart tv, basic utensils, tea, coffee, and kettles were all available at all times.
the location is close to a grocery store, cafés, and stores, so i wouldn’t mind doing a longer stay here again.

description: Spend your memorable long-term stay or business trip in this stylish apartment. Our 2 Bedroom Apartments has Terrace with City view. The apartment has 2 bedrooms, 1 living room with well-equipped kitchen and dining table.

reviews.text: Very beautiful and clean place !! Matched the picture . Worth the money you paid for ! Very respectful , helpful stuff . Nice place to stay . I highly recommend .

Great place! Very helpful host.
Gorgeous apartment, lots of space, very clean, very comfortable beds. Would definitely recommend.

Generally a nice place to stay. Great view of Istanbul and lots of space. Gym downstairs was good.
On the downside, it was not very clean when we arrived and we had to spend time cleaning it. The cleaners only pop in every 3-4 days.
We were in an end room and the aircon was incredibly noisy.

The apartment is great, and the location is quite decent. However, I found that the host's responsiveness could be improved. For a smoother experience, I recommend communicating your needs directly at the reception, as the staff there were very helpful.

This place is actually a hotel. They ask for a deposit which is not in the Airbnb description.
The room was very spacious and had everything needed. Not expected was a huge balcony which not everyone has.
It was beside the freeway and the noise was very loud but we were exhausted and only stayed for one night.
The parking is free but a little creepy.
Lebanese restaurant in the lobby looked great but we didn’t have a chance to try it.

description:
The house is located in one of the most popular areas of the city. You’ll be enjoying the chic city center directly when you leave the apartment.

The street is quiet at night and very vibrant in the daytime.
We just newly renovated and decorated the place.

reviews.text:
My family and I enjoyed a delightful 8-day stay at Baris's flat, which boasted an excellent location. Numerous shops and restaurants were easily accessible, and a Metro station was a mere 5-minute walk away. The flat itself was spotless and well-presented, making for a pleasant stay.
Baris and her sister Cisel provided a warm and friendly welcome. Cisel, in particular, was exceptionally nice and went above and beyond in her efforts to ensure our comfort. She offered invaluable assistance on multiple occasions and even helped us to arrange a taxi for our journey to the airport.
I highly recommend this lovely place, not only for its amenities and location but also for the incredible hospitality provided by Cisel. We eagerly look forward to staying there again during our future visits.

I was in contact with Cisel, Baris sister’s
Very very nice person, friendly, she gave a lot of recommendations for restaurant and shops near the flat.
The flat is nice, clean, bed so confortable with AC , fan. Kitchen and bathroom perfect too.
Thank you very much

Tek kelimeyle mükemmeldi. Ev sahibi çok cana yakındı, misafirler uzun yoldan geliyor diye atıştırmalık yiyecekler koymuşlardı çok hoşuma gitti, evde tertemiz ve tam fotoğraftaki gibiydi her şey çok memnun kaldım.

Baris apartment was spotless and very well equipped,the beds so comfortable and the location of the apartment so convenient and located near metro .
Baris and his sister so friendly especially his sister was so helpful and proactive and keep checking us if we need anything and if we comfortable or not.
They are a good hosts and I recommend this apartment

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Baris apartment which was wonderful. From the exceptional location near the metro station to the warm and welcoming hosts.
The location of the apartment was absolutely perfect. Being close to the metro station made exploring the city incredibly convenient. It allowed me to effortlessly navigate and explore various attractions and neighborhoods at my own pace.
Baris and Cisel deserve a special mention. From the moment I arrived, they went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction throughout my stay. They were readily available to answer any questions, provide recommendations, and assist with any concerns I had.

description:
You'll love it here! Because it was prepared with total practicality and enjoyment in mind.

Located in the center of Istanbul, in the heart of Taksim, our apartment is located in Cihangir, a sympathetic neighborhood in terms of location. 1min walk to Taksim square and metro station

Thanks to fast WiFi, you can enjoy the internet at any time, find peace in the living room decorated on comfort and visual pleasure, sip your drink on the exquisite terrace overlooking the sea and enjoy the air:)

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay. The place is as described, super quiet despite being a 5min walk from Taksim. Comfy bed and pillows, nice water pressure. We didn’t use the kitchen as it’s so much easier to eat out. A small corner store is literally around the corner.
For those visiting for the first time and bringing luggage I recommend prearranging an airport transfer. Both the subway and airport bus stops are walking distance but the streets are very narrow and steep (think San Francisco) and partially cobbled. There is virtually no sidewalk or it’s a staircase. The apartment is one short flight of stairs up.

We had a lovely stay at Alphan’s place, with the apartment being as described, really spacious for 2, and very well located so you can travel around İstanbul easily.
Alphan is a cheerful, responsive host who does his best to go over and above to genuinely make your stay comfortable. He knew we were coming over for a birthday and was kind enough to get a cake as a welcome gift! He was always on hand to address any (minor) issues we faced during the stay and got them rectified immediately, therefore absolutely no complaints there either. Bonus points for the gorgeous views from the terrace of the building.
It was a fantastic 5 day stay and we would definitely come back the next time we are in Istanbul!

This was my second stay at Alphan's apartment.
It was very comfortable and a wonderful location for public transport and also close to see many places to go sightseeing by walking.
I work online so the WiFi was really strong in all areas of the apartment.
Alphan is a such a friendly, kind and helpful person with great English skills so it makes your stay smooth and easy.
I would recommend this apartment if you are having a holiday in Istanbul and want go sightseeing and enjoy the city with ease.

The location is very walkable with great restaurants and Taxim Square nearby. The place itself is extremely clean and has everything you need for a short or long stay, including a dishwasher and a TV with an HDMI cable. Istanbul gets hot in the summer, but the fan and curtains help a lot. Alphan was such an amazing host, one of the best we've had on Airbnb; always available to help but also leaving us to explore on our own (which we preferred, since we already knew the are well). Would highly recommend this flat and Alphan whether it's your first or 10th time coming to Istanbul!
Excellent place to stay for a trip to Istanbul. Well located, everything clean and tidy, good value and Alphan is a brilliant host.

description:
We have 5 different apartment in same building. Each one is big studio suite. Each one has 6 person capacity max. With this reservation you will have 2 different apartment in same building. İf you want more apartment we can provide it with extra payment.
We have hot water, wifi ...
WE HAVE 3+1 APARTMENT OPTİON ALSO
