WE ARE VERY CLOSE TO METRO AND OTHER PUBLİC TRANSPORTATİON

reviews.text:
We were a group of 6 and rented two apartments.
They were clean and comfortable.
Eren bought 2 toasters because we wanted to have breakfast in the apartments. The kitchenette is very small and could do would more work surfaces but we made do. It was serviceable.
Eren also bought us some food before we got there.
The place could also do with another chair and some bedside cabinets.
The bathrooms are small aswell and quite old. They could do with new taps but OK.
What we loved most was that it was so close to Taksim Square and Istiklal Street. The location was spot on.
Plenty of restaurants to eat from and local shops to buy food from.
The metro was in Taksim square and took you to Kabataş where you can get a tram to main tourist areas and ferries to Asian side.
Eren was wonderful. He was so responsive and helpful. He helped us with transport service and airport transfers.
All in all a great place to stay.

Pros:
Eren is a great host. He was always available so whenever you need anything you can call him.
We had trouble to check in but he really tried to make it up for us.
The location is great. So close to subway and restaurants and Istikbal st.
Eren provided water for us each time.
Cons:
awful smell in the street and the bathroom all the time.
The place was clean but not sparkly.
In the pictures looks like they are big units, but they’re smaller in fact.
Shower drain looked clogged so there was a bit issue.

Very close to Taksim Square and near to public transport such as bus, metro and nostalgic tram, excellent and friendly communication, Bathroom, bed and towels very clean. Kitchen was a bit under equipped, but when we needed something we got a solution in a few minutes. Very very friendly.

The upstairs unit was clean and comfortable, and the host was very responsive. However, the basement unit was not suitable for staying overnight due to sewage smell, dampness, and its very small size. I recommend booking the upstairs rooms instead.

I recently stayed at Eren Yusuf's place near Taksim square and was thoroughly impressed. The cleanliness was exceptional, and the location was perfect for exploring Istanbul's vibrant nightlife and attractions. Eren and his team provided outstanding hospitality, accommodating last-minute changes and offering early check-in and late check-out at no extra cost. I highly recommend this place and will definitely stay here again.

description: You will be in a central location, in peace, close to everywhere as a family.

reviews.text: The apartment is probably in the best location possible: 5 minutes walk to tram stop. Eminönü port, Blue Mosque and other famous places are within 10-20 minutes walk, many restaurants are at comfortable distance, but you will not feel the smells or hear noises. The place is quiet, despite the nearby train station which is not noisy at all and seems to have no night traffic. The street is also quiet with few cars passing throughout the day. The windows have mosquito nets which is very useful, once you want to open them. Host is easy accessible if needed, apartment is clean and spacious. The only minor issue was a small water leak from shower cabin into the bathroom. We stayed for six nights and would definitely choose again

The location of the Airbnb was excellent and within walking distance of most major attractions, which made exploring the area very convenient. The check-in process was smooth, and the accommodation generally met our expectations.
However, we experienced some issues during our stay. The air conditioning was not working properly, which made the apartment uncomfortable at times, especially during warmer hours. We also noticed a significant amount of dust in certain areas, and the overall cleanliness could be improved.
Overall, the location is a major advantage, but addressing the air conditioning and cleanliness issues would greatly enhance the guest experience.

very strategic apartment position. close to all places of interest. go everywhere just by walking. very nice apartment with kitchen facilities, room heater, good hot water. The host and host Mr. Salih & Mr. Derya are very helpful with questions related to places to go, helping to store our luggage when leaving Istanbul. they also help provide airport transfers at reasonable prices. The location of this apartment is close to Mamaray and Sikerci tram stations. Gulhane Park is right behind the apartment

Derya's place was great for my family and I's short trip to Istanbul. The apartment building is located right by the entrance to the gorgeous historic Gülhane Park, a short and pleasant walk away from the the Topkapi Palace complex and Hagia Sophia (and a myriad other museums and historic places, as well as cafes, restaurants, shops, bars, etc.) Despite proximity to tourist attractions, the building felt quiet and hidden from the hustle and bustle of bigger streets.
The apartment was spacious, comfortable, and clean, perfectly sized for three people. The host, Salih, was responsive and kind.
Perhaps the only thing that was somewhat disagreeable was the AC - it was too weak for the hot and humid weather of August in Istanbul, although I think it must work perfectly fine in cooler months.
However, it was overall a VERY positive experience! I would recommend this apartment!

Value for money
Well Maintained
Good room size
Good kitchen
Very neat & clean bathroom
Amazing location
Good communication
Fully satisfied

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
The apartment is in a great, quiet location and the check-in was easy. The host was friendly and responded quickly, but I didn’t appreciate being pushed to leave a perfect review — I prefer to be honest for future guests.
While the photos make the place look modern and high-end, the reality was different. The furniture and floor were visibly worn, and there was a large brown stain on the wall. The worst part was a musty smell (like damp hay) coming from the bathroom, which made it necessary to run the AC constantly.
The apartment was generally clean, though the sink was a bit clogged. The bed was fairly comfortable but small for two people. Wi-Fi was available but occasionally unreliable. We didn’t use the kitchen-area, but everything seemed to be there.
Overall, it was okay for 5 nights, but don’t expect the polished look shown in the listing.

The apartment is small but very clean and located in a great area of Kadıköy. It has everything you need for a comfortable stay, including air conditioning. Check-in was very smooth and easy. Hakan is a very friendly and responsive host, which made the stay even more pleasant.
The apartment is on a high floor with no elevator. It’s not too difficult to walk up, but it can be a bit challenging if you have heavy luggage or are traveling with a baby.
Thank you, Hakan, for a great stay!

The apartment was exceptionally clean and comfortable! The highlight, however, was the bathroom and shower—immaculate and luxurious. It truly refreshes you after a long trip. Everything was as described, and all amenities were readily available. Hakan was very responsive and even accommodated an early check-in, which was greatly appreciated since I was already in the neighborhood.

The host was very responsive and polite , always willing to help and resolve any questions. The place itself is as decribed in the photo, was very clean. The location is also very good, not noisy. We were very pleased and would come back to the same apartment. Everything was very good. Self-checkin was easy and helpful.

Evin konumu harika. Hem Kadıköy sahile hem de YHT garına 13-15 dk yürüme mesafesinde. Ev tertemizdi. Birçok airbnb evinin mutfağındaki gereçler kullanılamaz halde, çizik içinde ya da kirli olur. Bu evdekiler sahiden çok iyi durumdaydı. Asansör yok ama merdivenler geniş, yine de büyük bavul çıkarmak zor olabilir. Klima çalışır görünüyor ama soğutmuyordu. Pencerelerde sineklik yok, bir gece sivrisinekle mücadele etmemiz gerekti. Cadde gürültülü. 5. katta olduğumuz halde gece gürültüden rahatsız olduk. En büyük rahatsızlığımız yataktı. Çok rahatsızdı. Hem dar, hem de çöküyordu. Ev sahibi çözüm odaklı ve hemen cevap veriyor. Ancak bu saydığım sorunlar hemen çözülecek türden değildi. Bu nedenle tam bir konfor yaşadık diyemem. Fayda maliyet oranı bu nedenle düşük benim açımdan.

description: This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

reviews.text: The house was just as it appeared in the pictures, house was generally very clean but the bathroom was dirty. location is pretty far away from central but metro was very close to house transportation within the city was not difficult. But I cant say anything good about the host. Although she was in the same place, I informed her before (30 min) I came the day we went. She didnt give enough information and made us wait, walk in the rain. She never answer her phone when she have to. We only called her before we came and left but she didn’t answer. Before we leave the house, I started calling again 30 minutes ago and I couldn't get an answer. I missed my bus ticket because Nur replied 35 minutes after leave time and said “you can leave the key at home” She didnt even come to take keys and made me late for that message. it was the worst airbnb experience i've ever had, definitely not worth it.
Evin temiz olması çok önemliydi. Ki fotoğraflardaki gibi düzenli şık ve temizdi. Gönül rahatlığıyla konakladık. Konumu kolay. Şehir manzarası güzel.
Daire fotoğraflardaki gibi, ferah,temiz ve manzarası çok güzel.Güvenlikli bir site ve otoparkı çok geniş düşünmeden tercih edebilirsiniz.
Temiz ve düzenliydi ev sahibi samimiydi
It was exactly as expected. Nur was very helpful.

description:
The flat is very close to famous Istiklal Street.

Beyoğlu region and Galata was rebuilt after a big fire in 1870. We would define this date as the rebirth of Beyoğlu and say that many important historical buildings in Beyoğlu emerged after this date. The building was completed in 1872 by French architects in a European style. You will feel 150 years of history at this place.

reviews.text: Beautiful house looks exactly like the pictures and has everything that you need. The location was very close to istiklal (around 12 min on foot), all while being very calm, many restaurants are close by, and a grocery store and bakery are just around the corner. the hosts are very kind and helpful and respond really fast, we did a last minute reservation (around one hour before check-in) yet they responded immediately and even with the short notice mr Baran came to meet us and show us the apartment which was very kind of him and meant a lot to us. All in all, I highly recommend this house, it was a perfect experience from beginning to end, and we will definitely come back again.

We loved this house! Since the house is a detached building, it was very cozy and comfortable. The supplies that could be needed in the kitchen were sufficient. The building location is quite central but also in a quiet street. The terrace is very cute. It was a pleasure to dine here with the family and just relax on the swing. I am grateful for this wonderful experience. Recommended!

Merve & Ahmet’s place was worth every penny, it’s in a fantastic location, beautifully decorated and in a safe and peaceful area. They helped me so much while I was there including coming at short notice with extra towels and then again to help explain how to use the washing machine. Check in and check out was very easy and they were flexible when I arrived late. Thanks to both of them!

The apartment is great and perfect for accommodating four people comfortably. It is well equipped with everything needed for a pleasant stay. The location is excellent, in a quiet and peaceful area, yet very close to the city center, just 5 minutes from the Galata Tower.
The only thing that could be improved is the availability of outlets on the top floor of the apartment. An extension cord would be a useful addition for guests who need to charge electronic devices.
Overall, your Airbnb in Istambul deserves 5 stars, as it exceeded expectations and provided a pleasant and comfortable stay. I would recommend this apartment to anyone planning to visit the region.

Located at the center of galata district, the apartment was very cute and renovated quite recently. It had all the small comforts we needed during our stay whilst visiting Istanbul. The location of the apartment and proximity to istanbul public transport system made our travels within the city very convenient. The galata district is quite lively and attracts a lot of people, but the apartment is located away from all the noise and the chaos. If you want to visit Istanbul and stay in one of the most historic districts, while having the advantage of easy to access public transport, this is the place to stay. Merve and Ahmet were very supportive when we had any inquiries and quick to communicate with us. Rest at ease if you want to book their apartment. You will be treated right.

description:
You can enjoy a safe and quiet neighborhood.
Insider tips for delicious local food and places to visit as locals do.

reviews.text: I really enjoyed my stay! love the neighborhood!The place was adorable! clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was so helpful!

This is not your standard soulless airbnb but a beautiful home. The house is really charming with a lot of space and a beautiful interior. Super cozy! There is a kitchen equipped with everything you need to make yourself a meal. The bed is really big and comfortable, the bath and shower clean and really nice. The house is located perfectly if you want to discover the main sights in Karaköy, Eminönü, Galata on the european side as well as the neighbourhoods Kadiköy and Moda on the anatolian side. Around Dogancilar you‘ll also find cafes and shops. Thanks for hosting us Buket!

Nice cosy house. Spacious. Clean. Comfortable bed. Walkable distance to ferries and metro, easy to get to the histroric centre. No through traffic in the street, so no traffic noise. Good neighbourhood. Host was friendly, helpful and responsive.

Previous guests have said it all about this charming home: spick and span with a well-equipped kitchen, two lounge areas for relaxing in, and a roomy bedroom with a very comfortable bed.
Buket really does think of everything: a note of welcome was pinned by the front door and food had been left in the ‘fridge as a nice surprise. Buket could be contacted 24/7 and she responded promptly. Early check-in was no problem, and neither was late check-out. Many thanks to a true SuperHost and her SuperMum.
Nearby, are all sorts of eating-places and supermarkets, and the Mamaray train apart, ferries (from Üsküdar and Harem) regularly cross the Bosphorus to Stamboul and farther afield. What more wonderful way to begin and end a day’s sight-seeing in this most bewitching of cities?

There is so much I could say about the area, Buket and the space itself -- I enjoyed it so much! It was a life-saver after a stinky, overpriced, crappy Airbnb I had in Cihangir. Buket is a fabulous host who really goes above and beyond for her guests. The house/neighborhood had a lovely familial cottage vibe where there were days I simply wanted to just stay in the area and at the home relaxing. The Uskudar ferry can take you everywhere, is easy, cheap and a really enjoyable experience. The neighborhood is not inundated with tourists ensuring the culture has yet to be overrun by the modern day overflow of post-pandemic digital nomads (sorry not sorry). The only criticism I could possibly have is that the seagulls are a bit loud but my partner said it reminded him of Cannes and liked it. I'm an unusually light sleeper so I think it is a me problem. Either way I adored Buket and the space, it made my trip and so did Buket's dedication to my comfort and overall enjoyment. THANK YOU BUKET!

description:
The flat is a modern renovation of a historical 18th century Istanbul building. The Pera region in the Beyoglu district of Istanbul is culturally significant; It is home to numerous galleries, bars, hotels and restaurants like the Pera Museum, Salt Art Gallery, Pera Palace Hotel and Soho House.
The flat is in the heart of Istanbul, 100 meters from Canir Istiklal Avenue, with restaurants and other cultural venues within a short walking distance.

reviews.text:
Amazing Stay in Istanbul!
We were three people staying at Necat’s apartment, and everything was perfect! The place is nice, very clean, and beautifully decorated — exactly like the photos, maybe even better. All the household tools and amenities were in excellent condition, which made our stay very comfortable.
The location is great, just a short walk from Galata Tower and close to many restaurants, shops, and public transport options — perfect for exploring Istanbul.
Necat was extremely helpful and friendly, always available whenever we needed something. His hospitality made our stay even better.
We truly enjoyed our time here and will definitely come back again on our next visit to Istanbul. Highly recommended!

I booked this Airbnb pretty last minute, and overall I can say it was a pretty great value for the price. The location is excellent, very walkable and close to all public transportation. The hosts were also incredibly responsive, any questions I had they answered back within minutes. The apartment is located on the first floor so you will hear people entering and leaving the building, it is an old building and there was a good deal of noise from the upstairs neighbors but it wasn’t an issue for us since we were out of the apartment for most of the day (definitely bring some earplugs if it will bother you). Overall we enjoyed our stay here, it was the perfect size apartment for two people and much roomier than if we had booked a hotel room.

Necate is a great host. he waited me 2hrs for check in!
the appt has very comfortable beds!
the location was in an old neighborhood and and in an old building. but it is very close from everything.
very clean apartment, a bit humid. but worth 100% the money.

Good location, very close to the tram stop, Galata port and Galata tower and min.10 walk to Istiklal but uphill. The apartment is equipped with all the necessary amenities for 4 people and a small kitchen. The apartment was super clean, everything was perfect. no complaints at all. Also, the hosts were super nice and kind, they answered every questions we had.
The noise from the street enters into living room, which is a bit noisy during weekends.

The apartment is like on the photos, at the ground floor, but reasonably quiet, on a very small sidestreet. The main street is commercial, with several great food shops very near the place. The street is narrow and the buildings are rather tall, so that the apartment is dark, one needs electric light even on a sunny day. We could not find some useful items, for example a kitchen towel, but I think Necat would have brought them if we asked (we only came for a couple of days, so we did not). He is a nice and friendly host, who probably does not speak foreign languages, but the communication is good with the automatic translator. Overall, we are satisfied and thankful.

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
I stayed here for a month and had a pleasant experience overall. The host Mr Ayet was friendly and responsive, always available to answer any questions.
The apartment was clean and comfortable, as it in the picture.The location is excellent, with A101, BİM, and other shops just a short walk away. Public transportation is very accessible: buses are 2 minutes away, the T5 tram line is about a 7-minute walk, and the Haliç M2 metro station is a 20-minute walk. The Wi-Fi was reliable, and the neighborhood was quiet and friendly. There’s also a mosque right in front of the building, which adds a peaceful ambiance to the area.
Overall, it was a convenient and comfortable place to stay for an extended period. I would recommend it to others looking for a well-located and hospitable place to stay.

I stayed here for a month, the location was ideal very close to public transport 5 minute walk to tram station, and bus stop. There is a grocery store only 2 minute walk away. Lots of food places around. The area is extremely safe and mosques in front and behind the apartment. Ayat is very friendly, he was very helpful with answering questions about locations and how to get around. He even offered an Istanbul card which is a transport card you can add money on and travel with. The apartment is VERY clean and sheets towels were spotless. He even let us borrow his adapter charger for our iPhones the entire month. If you want a clean, safe and close to Fatih apartment with A/C then look no further. This apartment also has a lift which is so convenient especially with having suitcases. Ayat also allowed us to stay in his unit to rest and refresh as we arrived super early due to our flight time and the tenants checked out - so we had a 4 hour time where we had to kill. Highly recommend!

It was a good stay with good location and privacy too
Great neighborhood and Ayet was friendly and helpful too ..
The only thing that is bad is the apartment need to be clean very well
As well as the kitchen basket/container and the refrigerator had a bad smell too ..
Also very crowded furniture .. the flat is small but there is too much & big furniture that makes the flat look very crowded and tight ..
Overall it was a good stay .. thank you Ayet for everything ..

My Istanbul retreat was a blissful experience thanks to this charming apartment. Its proximity to public transportation simplified my explorations of the city, while the peaceful ambiance of the building provided a welcome respite from the urban hustle.
The apartment is clean, with all amenities one needs, specially if you are staying for a longer period.
Yet, what truly elevated my stay was the exceptional attentiveness of the landlord. Their genuine hospitality and eagerness to assist with any request made me feel valued and cared for throughout my visit.
If you seek a tranquil haven in Istanbul, this apartment is the perfect choice. With its convenient location, serene atmosphere, and attentive landlord, it offers an exceptional experience that I whole recommend.

The flat is comfortable and it has all you need for your stay. It is sparkling clean and It is close to everything from tourism attractions to transport facilities and arround it there are markets, bakery, restaurants, grocery ,etc..
Ayat is a wonderful host, he is very welcoming and genious person. He provided his own house when the hotel cancelled our booking and requested a taxi to pick us from there to his house. He is very kind and provided much more than we expected. Many many thanks Ayat.

description:
Stay at our perfect 2 bedroom at a new apartment complex with everything that you may need at your fingertips.

There is a Starbucks, a Migros grocery store, high quality restaurants, a hairdresser, a pharmacy and much more at the premises.

The building offers a fully equipped gym, a pool and free parking.

reviews.text:
We stayed in this apartment during our one month trip and enjoyed its comfort and convenience.
The apartment is clean and perfect, with all the things you need at home, it has a beautiful view of the city, excellent 24-hour security, quick and easy check-in and check-out, fast and responsive support, nearby restaurants and supermarkets, 24-hour taxi station. most importantly, the subway station is right next to this apartment, where you can travel to all of Istanbul with a low cost and without traffic. Thank you from Away suites for the beautiful apartment and our good stay.

The host work so communicated, organise and very kind, the area is very close to metro , there is 2 coffee shop starbugs and espresso lab, some local amenities like shop pharmacy and hairdresser , area is very nice quiet and comfortable , you can use gym,indoor swim and outdoor swim perfect for summer , flat is comfortable and very pleasant , I was very happy of the apartment and location , there is one improvement they would need to look at but other than that is perfect for really reasonable price you will
Love to live there and enjoy your trip in beautiful city like is Istanbul
Thank you very much for all of your perfect organisation and host
Marta
Our host was perfect. We had a smooth check in, 5 star hotel standart cleanliness and cosy room. Can’t beat price/value definetly recommend

Mr. Leon Arslan, an amazing host, does everything possible to make his guest feel comfortable. He always responded to my text messages during my stay, through a solution, always responsive, flexible and a great communicator. I had everything I needed. What is the plus in the apartment if for a long term then, you can use the fitness and swimming pool included in the price, this is a good privilege of the residence. I recommend .

The host was very responsive, with clear instructions. The appartment was as described.
One thing that could be better is sound-proofing, especially windows.

description:
The flat is in the heart of Cihangir (hipster area of İstanbul) with a very central location. Just a minute walk to cafes and restaurants. 10 min walk toTaksim Square and Istiklal Street. 8 min walk to the tram to Hagia Sophia or Topkapı Palace. 10 min walk to Galata Port and Bosphorus Strait. Enjoy the perfect location with elegant design.
Note: The building is just 3 years old and compatible with earthquake regulations.

reviews.text: A nice, clean, modern, and quiet apartment. It looked just like the pictures and had everything needed for a comfortable stay. It is in a central but quiet neighborhood, walkable to good restaurants and grocery stores. The hosts had great communication and check in and out were very easy. I would stay in this apartment again.

The flat is in a great neighborhood, and it looks like its photos. I appreciated that it was equipped with small things that make long-term stays easier--laundry detergent, salt, extra toilet paper, etc. It also included bottled water delivery, which was great. The flat was quiet, the water pressure was good, the bed was comfortable. The living room is a bit small, and the kitchen is also small for really cooking. The hosts were responsive.

This is a cute & quiet small-ish one bedroom apartment in a quiet, secure, elevator building. Everything feels new and the apartment was very clean upon arrival. Great location, great restaurants nearby, very quiet inside the apartment, great water pressure (and shower head), and nice mattress (on the firm side)…slept really well. Highly recommend for someone who wants a chill place without many grills to return to at the end of the day or to return to for an afternoon siesta.

Airbnb was a clean and comfortable place to stay. The living room kitchen area was a bit small but a nice size bathroom and bedroom. Recommend their place if you want to explore the area. The hills and steps in the area require some physical stamina. The apartment is on the 4th floor with spiral steps. There is an elevator but unfortunately it wasn't working when we were there. Cihan was very responsive. He also provides some touring tips and arranges shuttles to the airport for you.

I can highly recommend this place. I stayed for 5 days and everything was perfect. Very clean, everything in good condition, easy check in/out, comfy bed, fast Internet, very quiet area (day and night) and one of the best neighborhoods (to reach all monuments and to find restaurants, bars,…)

description:
Experience a Stylish, Local Stay in the Heart of Istanbul

Make yourself at home in this cozy, 5-minute walk from Galata Tower, Istiklal Street, and Soho House Istanbul

Şişhane Metro Station right next door, the neighborhood is full of amazing cafes, bars, and restaurants serving both local and international flavors

The apartment is on the 5th floor of a historic building

Please note there is no elevator

As per local laws, all guests must provide valid Passport or ID information at check-in

reviews.text: The place itself is cosy and rustic as described, comfy bed, smooth check in. I’ve stayed in a lot of bnbs and this place could be improved by a cleaner kitchen, the toasty maker was dirty, there is no basic cooking things like oil or pepper. The heaters don’t work as well, or maybe they just take hours to heat up. if you come back at night there are no lights coming up the stairs which are very narrow so it’s hard to see. It is an elegant little apartment tho so we enjoyed the location.

I had an amazing experience at this Airbnb! The place was exactly as described, clean, and well-maintained. The host was incredibly welcoming and responsive, making sure I had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The location was perfect—quiet yet conveniently close to local attractions. I especially loved the thoughtful touches, like extra towels and snacks. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

The place has a great potential: the vibe, authentic interior, the location - everything was there.
However, the maintenance level is horrible. Lots of clutter, old sweaters in the wardrobe mixed with hair and dust, dirty fridge, strange stained volumes of old used paper in the basket/table in the living room, didn't look like the floor was ever washed, bathroom isn't cleaned and toilet paper not changed, loooots of dust everywhere and a questionable freshness of the bed sheets.
We stayed for one night as the arrival time was late, but the next day I've realized that this place would ruin the rest of our stay and we moved out to a nearest clean hotel for the same money.
Hope the host will clean up the place and it could be a great spot, till then I would highly recommend to find something else.
Amazing responsive host, apartment was exactly as described and location is great, close to everything you’d want from cafe’s, to restaurants to bars and a metro station

The flat is very well located for exploring the European side of Istanbul and having a metro station so close made things easier, especially after the journey from the airport.
We really liked the creative and unique style of the interior and the interesting arty books. It feels like a place to relax and be at home after busy days of walking around the city.
There's some good cafes close bye which is nice.
Be aware that there's quite a lot of steps up to the flat. Also, that there's music playing from clubs at night during the weekend, so if you are noise sensitive, it's worth having earplugs for sleeping. But don't let this put you off as it's a great flat and the owner is responsive and easy to contact if you need assistance.

description:
In these houses, Pillows and duvets cannot be used by anyone else beforehand. The most luxurious apartment in the building.
85 " (214 cm) SAMSUNG QLED TV.
Full furnished CVK HOME FURNITURE. Bedrooms furnished Pierre Cardin Home. Full+Full kitchen Siemens and SCHAFER utensils and also Coffee machine. The building is right in the heart of Taksim! A spacious residence with 3 rooms and a living room, 2 bathrooms, with pool, sauna, gym, steam room, cafeteria, free inside parking and 7/24 security.

reviews.text:
We had such an amazing stay at this apartment. The space is very big, bright, and beautifully clean — it felt comfortable from the moment we arrived. We especially loved the large sofa and the huge TV, which made it perfect for relaxing.
The location is fantastic, with Taksim Square just a five-minute walk away, making it very convenient to explore the city. The amenities were a real highlight — the pool and sauna were absolutely wonderful, and we enjoyed them a lot. The beds were very comfortable, and everything in the apartment was well-maintained and spotless.
The staff downstairs at reception and security were always kind, friendly, and helpful. The owners were also incredibly welcoming — they gave us great recommendations on where to go and what to see, and were always available if we needed anything. They even surprised us with small gifts both before our arrival and after our stay, which was such a thoughtful and special touch.
Overall, it was a truly lovely experie

We stayed at Muhammet's place for a family holiday. It was a slightly different flat from the pictures but we didn't mind as we'd asked for one as far away from the street as possible so we were given a flat on the top floor which was great. Comfortable and spacious. Separate AC units in each room. Also v good heating if you're coming in colder months. Be aware that you will hear the call to prayer (it was only the early morning one that we really noticed) but that's probably unavoidable anywhere in Istanbul. If you have young children, also useful to be aware that there aren't shutters/blinds so the sun does come through the curtains.
Muhammet was a lovely host, incredibly responsive, v friendly. Reception staff also v helpful and friendly. Very handy cafe on site. Our kids absolutely loved the pool which was nice and warm. Good location, short walk to Taksim Square and local buses to all the main tourist sites (though up a very steep hill!) Would definitely recommend!

We stayed at this apartment for a family reunion. That was a perfect match, as the place is really big and everyone could have their place.
Everything in the apartment is just like you see at the photos - the only thing is that it feels a bit older than you’d imagine, and the windows have some little holes near the wall, so it was a bit chilly in the kitchen and one of the bedrooms (we travelled in December).
The location is good - lots of places to eat, 10 minutes walk to Taksim (but when with our elderly parents, we still had to use taxi as there was a slope too steep for them, but that’s just what Istanbul is).
When we had any questions, Deniz was quick to help and respond. We also liked that the building has a reception, so check in and check out are super smooth and easy.
Overall can recommend the place.

we have traveled with family 5 adults and 2 kids. the apartment is like in photos, no any problem with heating (our kids are used with 24 degrees) , communication is the best i had ever, very friendly and helpful staff, i have read some comments regarding the noise but we had no any problem, close to everywhere , private parking 24/7, Muhammet is really great person, the apartment is full equipped, best restaurant in area is the local grill by dogan chef, staff is ready to help anytime. recommend the place. thank you for your hospitality

The apartment is nice and clean
Good comfortable furniture and a great large TV
Great location near Taksim square
Muhammet was super nice and responsive
He even gave us a couple of nice gifts
Overall we had a nice stay
We definitely recommend the place and plan to go back next year
Cheers

description: If you prefer this centrally located flat, you will be close to everywhere with your family. You will have a comfortable and peaceful trip by taking advantage of the facilities at home!

reviews.text: We have booked Mustafa's place for 5 days and we didn't regret it at all. We were 4 adults and a child and the place was quite adequate. What we like the most was the location of this place as there are many restaurants and shops in the vicinity. Mustafa's apartment is just 5-10 min. walk to Eyüpsultan Mosque. The apartment has all the necessary amenities and was clean when we visited. There is also no parking issue. During checkin there was an issue that the apartment alloted to us was not clean and when I reported it to Mustafa, he was quite responsive and immediately told us to move to another apartment downstairs. Another issue was that hot water wasn't working to which Mustafa also took a quick action and fixed it. Overall a wonderful experience but I believe Mustafa also should improve his management skills such that following issues never happen. Last but not least, Mustafa has booked the apartment for a day more as compensation to what we went through. Great goodwill gesture!

The place was spacious and clean. Overall we enjoyed our stay. We had a bit of concern about the stairs to the room which was better when we moved to the first floor. The neighbourhood is good and the location is close to malls and attractions.
The only issue we faced was the poor communication (as the host was on a trip) and lack of check in instructions which made us wait for couple of hours, and wandering around the place to find someone who could speak English.

Konum itibariyle çok iyi. Tüm ulaşım araçlarına çok yakın. Evdeki bazı cihazlarda sorun yaşadık fakat Mustafa Bey sorunlarımızı çözmek içiñ hızlı bir şekilde yardımcı oldu. Fiyat performans olarak beğendik

Location is great, lots of cafes and restaurants and more to visit, only for ~800tl from IST airport,
The apartment is good feels homey but bathroom is not really good.
Early check in is possible
Evin konumu harika giriş çıkış çok kolaydı ev tertemizdi benim sık sık kaldığım yer sizlerde güvenle kalabilirsiniz

description: Perfect for corporate stays, remote working and digital nomads! A stroll to the glamour of Nisantasi or the vibrant neighbourhood of Macka. Our apartment is a 5 mins walk from Swiss Hotel and St Regis Hotel and Macka Park. It’s perfect for walks, restaurants, shopping, bars and kids play areas. Stylish decor coupled with high end furnishings, brand new appliances and a focus on extreme comfort - your stay is guaranteed to be fabulous! A Penthouse, a Bosphorus view and an elevator too!

reviews.text:
Zeynep is a real great host. She is communicating in great way, starting from the welcoming message along to the “very detailed” instructions and hints about her apartment and the surrounding area.
She -and her local located friend- were very proactive whenever we needed help regardless of the time. It was my first time in Istanbul so I found it not suitable location at first as it is located between small streets, however, later on , I discovered that I am surrounded by many helpful services. The building is secure, clean, and very quiet. The apartment amenities are as handy as described. It is a very cozy place for a great break. I highly recommend this experience.

Zeynep’s place was brilliant, great value for money and great location, Flat was clean and welcoming, beds were comfy and the shower was great. The flat was a great stay and would recommend it to anyone.

This was easily one of the best Airbnb stays we had and we stayed in a lot of them. The apartment is located in one of Istanbul’s best neighborhoods. Very walkable, surrounded by great restaurants, 5-star hotels and shopping. A taxi stop is around the corner. Zeynep’s home is a 2 level condo that is completely and very tastefully remodeled. There’s one bedroom and one bathroom downstairs along with the living room and open kitchen. Upstairs are two more bedrooms, another bathroom, laundry room and family room. We found all the comforts we are accustomed to and more. Several luxury additions such as a Toto toilet, Smeg range and central air conditioning make this place special. The beds are super comfortable and the furnished terrace has million dollar views. We truly enjoyed our stay and wish we could stay longer!

Other than how responsive and helpful and generous Zeynep was, the place is uniquely clean, tidy, cozy, well decorated and perfectly maintained. all amenities and appliances are of excellent quality. The photos are not doing justice to the place. The upper floor terrace has an astonishing panoramic Bosphorus view that one can't get enough of , truly a unique advantage. Moreover, the mattresses pillows and linen were excellent. in other words, the place was a PERFECT stay.

I had an exceptional stay at the Nisantasi Penthouse! Its prime location near coffee shops, restaurants, and high-end shops made my experience truly delightful. The apartment's sparkling cleanliness and well-equipped amenities exceeded my expectations. Zeynap's hospitality and responsiveness added a personal touch to my stay. I look forward to returning and highly recommend this apartment to everyone.

description:
This huge, stylish and elegant apartment offers a unique hamam bathroom where you can relax on a warmed marble slab to the sound of water flowing from the antique carved sink. The shared terrace has gorgeous views across the Golden Horn to the Old City.

We also offer a selection of 'experiences' with our local guides, to help you build your own genuine and memorable perspective on the city.

reviews.text:
This place has some pros but many cons.
Cons:
--One of the three bedrooms smelled like an animal had died in the room.
--the hot water in the shower fluctuates from hot to cold, so you are never quite comfortable
--There was a lizard in the bathroom a few of the nights
--Now, all this would have been fine if the price had not been much much higher than other comparable properties. In fact, the price was the same as the hosts other "newly renovated" properties that the host has in the same building.
pros:
the view is stunning
location is excellent
communication is prompt and friendly
amenities are there
the hamam was a nice touch

Had a great stay at Julia & Tarkan’s place. As per previous reviews the view from the rooftop is spectacular, spent some good time there. However it’s 6 flights of stairs to get up/down, it’s a hefty task especially after walking around all day. They’ve also changed
the furniture on the rooftop vs the photos, much more basic now. Beds are comfortable, AC’s in each bedroom are portable ones, they do the job but are noisy and hard to get temp right (too cold or too warm) but better than none especially in summer. No AC in living area which is a bit annoying, they supply you a fan but does little on hot days/nights. Never understood how to use Hamam- it’s just a warm stone table .. probably good for winter. Large unit with lots of space and excellent, albeit noisy location. Hosts and manager are very friendly and very responsive. Great kitchen & amenities with dishwasher. Washer but no dryer - have to hang clothes In apartment which can be messy. Overall great with a few minor issues

Simply perfect! A place where pictures don't do justice to the beauty of this place. Apartment including all amenities were in pristine condition where I was met by Taskin (manager) which got me well acquainted with the flat within a few minutes. Location is an absolute bonus where you are a few meters away from the square where Galata tower is located and a 10min downhill walk from Karakoy. Beds and pillows, all dressed with fresh clean white linen were ultra-comfortable for a perfect uninterrupted sleep. Amenities provided in the kitchen were pretty decent and more than enough to cook if you have time and intend to do so. View on the communal terrace was stunning, without hesitation far better than any of the surrounding terraces and simply on par with Galata tower itself. I highly recommend not only this apartment but all of which Tarkan and Julia host after having an unforgettable great experience. I would also like to thank them once again for providing me an early-check in.

Just next to Galata tower, you step outside the stairs and there you have Galata. Spacious 3 BHK apartment with nicely done modern IKEA kitchen, 2 bed rooms are good size, middle one is slightly small but with queen bed,.\ 2 full bathrooms, one includes hammam as well. Apartment is well maintained and almost all basic requirements are provided. Access to terrace on 6th floor is icing on the cake, its very idle for good photo shoots of Galata tower in background and also of the scenic Istanbul, Hagia Sophia, Blue mosque, and other attractions and sea coast.
Good restaurants, grocery stores, gift shops are nearby.
Superb hosts, very responsive. Proactively provided recommendations, dos and dont's which are very helpful for tourist.
There is a small pocket size book in collection for daily use of Turkish language and also two Istanbulkart - this is very thoughtful.
Would highly recommend the place and hosts, everything was simply superb.

We spent a full two weeks in the private hamam property hosted by Julia & Tarkan so we have a pretty good understanding of the area, and the apartment. First of all, the hosts are wonderful and provided quick responses to any messages along with some good suggestions for restaurants in the area before our arrival. They are out of the country but have a great property manager (Taskin) on site who greeted us on arrival and was equally fast to respond the couple of times we messaged him.
The location of the place is fantastic. We loved being in the Galata neighbourhood with tons of shops and restaurants so close. Getting over to sultanahmet to see a few of the “must see” sites was easy by tram and we are so happy that we didn’t actually stay over there. Just keep in mind that the tram is at the bottom of a small but somewhat steep hill. Not a big deal and a great walk, and only something to consider if you have mobility issues. The Galata Tower is a proper site seeing destination for obligatory selfies in front of it. We didn’t bother going to the top of it as the rooftop terrace in the apartment building offered similar views of Istanbul whenever we wanted without a line up. Only thing we will say about the location is that you will get some street noise being so close to the action of the neighbourhood and the apartment is just up one flight of stairs from street level. This was always people leaving bars/restaurants in the area late at night; not traffic or sirens. Some nights were louder than others so if you’re a light sleeper, one of the upper level apartments might be a consideration.
The apartment itself was great. Beautiful place really. We actually enjoyed having the hamam in the apartment. Nice feature and a relaxing space to come home to after walking the streets and site seeing all day. Air conditioning in the bedrooms worked great when needed. There is a washing machine out of view in the kitchen and a foldable drying rack (no drying machine) which was fine and made the place reasonable for an extended stay like ours. Beds were comfortable.
All in all, we’d be happy to stay there again.

description: Experience the charm of this modern and stylish one bedroom apartment in the heart of Beyoğlu, Istanbul. Within easy walking distance of lively Istiklal Street, historic landmarks, and trendy cafes, this apartment offers a cozy and peaceful retreat in the city center.
